requirements.full_text: Dashboard Mobile Priority Order - On mobile, order the page by owner decision value: health/phase -> true active owner actions -> launch blockers -> product/creative truth -> spend -> operations detail/audit trail. Avoid forcing the owner through long low-value tables to find blockers.

requirements.title: Dashboard Compact Drilldown
requirements.text: Large tables (audit trail, incidents, agents, learning changes) default to concise summaries with expandable/drilldown detail so mobile status remains readable without losing evidence.
requirements.full_text: Dashboard Compact Drilldown - Large tables (audit trail, incidents, agents, learning changes) default to concise summaries with expandable/drilldown detail so mobile status remains readable without losing evidence.

requirements.title: Last-Deployed SHA and Verification
requirements.text: Dashboard header shows deployed commit SHA, deployment time and last successful production verification, preventing confusion between newly pushed fixes and an older rendered dashboard.
requirements.full_text: Last-Deployed SHA and Verification - Dashboard header shows deployed commit SHA, deployment time and last successful production verification, preventing confusion between newly pushed fixes and an older rendered dashboard.

requirements.title: Data Timestamp Consistency
requirements.text: Every major card/table exposes observation/as-of time where freshness matters; mixed snapshots cannot silently appear as one current state.
requirements.full_text: Data Timestamp Consistency - Every major card/table exposes observation/as-of time where freshness matters; mixed snapshots cannot silently appear as one current state.

requirements.title: Owner Queue Empty Guard
requirements.text: An empty active owner queue closes nothing by itself; assessment health and gate evidence must prove the empty state, preserving the guard Claude just implemented.
requirements.full_text: Owner Queue Empty Guard - An empty active owner queue closes nothing by itself; assessment health and gate evidence must prove the empty state, preserving the guard Claude just implemented.

requirements.title: Dashboard Contradiction Test
requirements.text: Automated acceptance test loads the assembled dashboard model and rejects contradictions such as model ceiling present + 'no spend limits', expected refusals + defect-like headline, or satisfied shop + active 'open shop' action.
requirements.full_text: Dashboard Contradiction Test - Automated acceptance test loads the assembled dashboard model and rejects contradictions such as model ceiling present + 'no spend limits', expected refusals + defect-like headline, or satisfied shop + active 'open shop' action.

requirements.title: Commercial Truth Above Vanity Counts
requirements.text: Top-level counts such as content pieces, listing images and certified releases are secondary to launch-cleared products, creative survivors, benchmark status and real commercial evidence. Do not let output volume imply business readiness.
requirements.full_text: Commercial Truth Above Vanity Counts - Top-level counts such as content pieces, listing images and certified releases are secondary to launch-cleared products, creative survivors, benchmark status and real commercial evidence. Do not let output volume imply business readiness.

requirements.title: Whole-Person Identity, Not Face Identity
requirements.text: A canonical Brambleloop model passes identity only when facial identity AND whole-person morphology remain consistent. A convincing face match cannot satisfy the gate by itself.
requirements.full_text: Whole-Person Identity, Not Face Identity - A canonical Brambleloop model passes identity only when facial identity AND whole-person morphology remain consistent. A convincing face match cannot satisfy the gate by itself.

requirements.title: Independent Morphology Hard Floor
requirements.text: Whole-person morphology is a separate hard floor from facial identity. Evaluate stature/build, shoulder width, torso length, waist/hip relationship, and chest/bust proportions within pose- and garment-aware tolerances. Material drift on any defining dimension fails the identity trial even when the face matches.
requirements.full_text: Independent Morphology Hard Floor - Whole-person morphology is a separate hard floor from facial identity. Evaluate stature/build, shoulder width, torso length, waist/hip relationship, and chest/bust proportions within pose- and garment-aware tolerances. Material drift on any defining dimension fails the identity trial even when the face matches.

requirements.title: Chest/Bust Continuity
requirements.text: For adult garment imagery, chest/bust volume and torso proportions are explicit identity features. Clothing may obscure or redistribute apparent contour, but the generator may not materially resize the person's anatomy between reference and output. The reference/output pair observed on 2026-09-20 is a regression fixture: the face is similar while chest morphology materially differs, therefore the trial must fail whole-person identity.
requirements.full_text: Chest/Bust Continuity - For adult garment imagery, chest/bust volume and torso proportions are explicit identity features. Clothing may obscure or redistribute apparent contour, but the generator may not materially resize the person's anatomy between reference and output. The reference/output pair observed on 2026-09-20 is a regression fixture: the face is similar while chest morphology materially differs, therefore the trial must fail whole-person identity.

requirements.title: Garment-Aware Morphology Judge
requirements.text: Identity judging must distinguish anatomy drift from silhouette changes caused by garment structure, padding, ease, pose, camera perspective and layering. When clothing prevents a defensible anatomy comparison, return UNMEASURABLE for that dimension rather than pass.
requirements.full_text: Garment-Aware Morphology Judge - Identity judging must distinguish anatomy drift from silhouette changes caused by garment structure, padding, ease, pose, camera perspective and layering. When clothing prevents a defensible anatomy comparison, return UNMEASURABLE for that dimension rather than pass.

requirements.title: Reference + Candidate Required
requirements.text: Every identity judge receives the canonical reference and generated candidate together. A one-image 'same person?' judgment is invalid and cannot write a score.
requirements.full_text: Reference + Candidate Required - Every identity judge receives the canonical reference and generated candidate together. A one-image 'same person?' judgment is invalid and cannot write a score.

requirements.title: Reference Conditioning Proven End-to-End
requirements.text: The generation request must prove the canonical reference was actually transmitted through the provider-specific adapter. Prompt text claiming 'same person as reference' is not evidence of conditioning.
requirements.full_text: Reference Conditioning Proven End-to-End - The generation request must prove the canonical reference was actually transmitted through the provider-specific adapter. Prompt text claiming 'same person as reference' is not evidence of conditioning.

requirements.title: Identity Trial Validity
requirements.text: A trial with missing reference bytes, unsupported provider conditioning, expired reference, missing judge pair, or unmeasurable morphology is INVALID/UNMEASURED - never a zero score and never evidence against a provider.
requirements.full_text: Identity Trial Validity - A trial with missing reference bytes, unsupported provider conditioning, expired reference, missing judge pair, or unmeasurable morphology is INVALID/UNMEASURED - never a zero score and never evidence against a provider.

requirements.title: Cross-Season Identity Pack
requirements.text: The canonical model is tested across at least three materially different contexts (for example fitted garment, loose/layered garment, and accessory/outerwear) so consistency is not inferred from two near-identical portraits.
requirements.full_text: Cross-Season Identity Pack - The canonical model is tested across at least three materially different contexts (for example fitted garment, loose/layered garment, and accessory/outerwear) so consistency is not inferred from two near-identical portraits.

requirements.title: Garment Fit Requires Stable Body
requirements.text: No garment-fit or sizing score is valid unless the model's relevant body morphology is within identity tolerance. If the body changes, the system cannot attribute fit differences to the garment.
requirements.full_text: Garment Fit Requires Stable Body - No garment-fit or sizing score is valid unless the model's relevant body morphology is within identity tolerance. If the body changes, the system cannot attribute fit differences to the garment.

requirements.title: Provider Benchmark Re-run Rule
requirements.text: Any provider scores produced by the broken identity protocol are superseded for identity-related dimensions. A corrected benchmark reruns affected trials; invalid historical scores remain in provenance but cannot contribute to winner selection.
requirements.full_text: Provider Benchmark Re-run Rule - Any provider scores produced by the broken identity protocol are superseded for identity-related dimensions. A corrected benchmark reruns affected trials; invalid historical scores remain in provenance but cannot contribute to winner selection.

requirements.title: Identity Subscores Exposed
requirements.text: Benchmark output reports face identity, whole-person morphology, and overall identity separately. A high face score may not hide a morphology failure inside an average.
requirements.full_text: Identity Subscores Exposed - Benchmark output reports face identity, whole-person morphology, and overall identity separately. A high face score may not hide a morphology failure inside an average.

requirements.title: Canonical Model Drift Sentinel
requirements.text: Customer-facing generations are compared with the canonical identity pack before release. Repeated near-threshold morphology drift raises an incident even if individual images narrowly pass, preventing gradual body drift across a season.
requirements.full_text: Canonical Model Drift Sentinel - Customer-facing generations are compared with the canonical identity pack before release. Repeated near-threshold morphology drift raises an incident even if individual images narrowly pass, preventing gradual body drift across a season.

requirements.title: Human Review Escalation Band
requirements.text: Borderline whole-person identity results enter a review band rather than being auto-passed. The system may auto-refuse obvious drift; it must not auto-approve ambiguous anatomy from obscured clothing or pose.
requirements.full_text: Human Review Escalation Band - Borderline whole-person identity results enter a review band rather than being auto-passed. The system may auto-refuse obvious drift; it must not auto-approve ambiguous anatomy from obscured clothing or pose.

requirements.title: Identity Benchmark Regression Fixture
requirements.text: Keep a sanitized regression representation of the 2026-09-20 failure class: same-looking face, materially different chest/torso morphology. Tests must prove the face-only implementation passes the face component but the whole-person gate refuses the asset.
requirements.full_text: Identity Benchmark Regression Fixture - Keep a sanitized regression representation of the 2026-09-20 failure class: same-looking face, materially different chest/torso morphology. Tests must prove the face-only implementation passes the face component but the whole-person gate refuses the asset.

requirements.title: Photographic Realism Hard Floor
requirements.text: Every customer-facing listing image must independently pass a photographic-realism gate. The target is a believable high-quality photograph of a real crochet product in a plausible environment, not merely attractive generated art. Obvious synthetic/AI appearance blocks release.
requirements.full_text: Photographic Realism Hard Floor - Every customer-facing listing image must independently pass a photographic-realism gate. The target is a believable high-quality photograph of a real crochet product in a plausible environment, not merely attractive generated art. Obvious synthetic/AI appearance blocks release.

requirements.title: Natural, Not Over-Polished
requirements.text: Do not optimize every frame toward sterile perfection. Prefer believable natural light, skin texture, hair, fabric behaviour, folds, ordinary poses, realistic homes/outdoor settings and controlled imperfection. Plastic skin, excessive beauty retouching, implausibly pristine scenes and generic AI-editorial/Pinterest perfection are release defects.
requirements.full_text: Natural, Not Over-Polished - Do not optimize every frame toward sterile perfection. Prefer believable natural light, skin texture, hair, fabric behaviour, folds, ordinary poses, realistic homes/outdoor settings and controlled imperfection. Plastic skin, excessive beauty retouching, implausibly pristine scenes and generic AI-editorial/Pinterest perfection are release defects.

requirements.title: Generative-Tell Rejection
requirements.text: Reject or regenerate images with impossible anatomy, malformed hands, inconsistent shadows/reflections, artificial depth of field, repeated or melted textures, incoherent props, fake-looking yarn, impossible stitch geometry, unexplained text/logos/brands, or other material generative artifacts.
requirements.full_text: Generative-Tell Rejection - Reject or regenerate images with impossible anatomy, malformed hands, inconsistent shadows/reflections, artificial depth of field, repeated or melted textures, incoherent props, fake-looking yarn, impossible stitch geometry, unexplained text/logos/brands, or other material generative artifacts.

requirements.title: MJs Photographic Benchmark
requirements.text: Use sanctioned MJsOffTheHookDesigns listing evidence as a benchmark for general photographic principles: lighting, framing, product scale, environment, styling, image sequence, detail coverage, model-vs-product balance and perceived naturalness. Learn mechanisms and standards only; do not reproduce their specific photos, compositions or protected creative expression.
requirements.full_text: MJs Photographic Benchmark - Use sanctioned MJsOffTheHookDesigns listing evidence as a benchmark for general photographic principles: lighting, framing, product scale, environment, styling, image sequence, detail coverage, model-vs-product balance and perceived naturalness. Learn mechanisms and standards only; do not reproduce their specific photos, compositions or protected creative expression.

requirements.title: Gallery-as-Real-Photo-Shoot
requirements.text: A listing gallery must read as one coherent, believable photo shoot rather than unrelated generated hero images. Where relevant include hero, useful alternate angles, scale/context, construction/detail close-ups and worn/fit views. Maintain consistent product identity, materials, colour and construction across frames.
requirements.full_text: Gallery-as-Real-Photo-Shoot - A listing gallery must read as one coherent, believable photo shoot rather than unrelated generated hero images. Where relevant include hero, useful alternate angles, scale/context, construction/detail close-ups and worn/fit views. Maintain consistent product identity, materials, colour and construction across frames.

requirements.title: Canonical Model Naturalism
requirements.text: The canonical Brambleloop model must remain identity- and morphology-locked while still looking like a real person photographed on different days. Permit natural variation in pose, expression, hair and setting; reject copy-paste sameness, over-smoothed skin and artificial glamour that makes the model look synthetic.
requirements.full_text: Canonical Model Naturalism - The canonical Brambleloop model must remain identity- and morphology-locked while still looking like a real person photographed on different days. Permit natural variation in pose, expression, hair and setting; reject copy-paste sameness, over-smoothed skin and artificial glamour that makes the model look synthetic.

requirements.title: Product Truth Outranks Beauty
requirements.text: Crochet fidelity outranks photographic beauty. The pictured object must agree with the certified pattern/CIR/digital twin on visually material construction: stitch structure, motif, repeat geometry, shaping, seams/joins, edging, dimensions, colour placement, drape and garment fit. A beautiful photograph of the wrong object fails.
requirements.full_text: Product Truth Outranks Beauty - Crochet fidelity outranks photographic beauty. The pictured object must agree with the certified pattern/CIR/digital twin on visually material construction: stitch structure, motif, repeat geometry, shaping, seams/joins, edging, dimensions, colour placement, drape and garment fit. A beautiful photograph of the wrong object fails.

requirements.title: Motif & Construction Fidelity Gate
requirements.text: Where the certified pattern specifies a motif, repeat or visually material construction feature, imagery must faithfully depict it. The observed checkerboard-versus-diamond-lattice failure is a permanent regression fixture: matching category, colour, dimensions and lighting cannot rescue incorrect motif geometry.
requirements.full_text: Motif & Construction Fidelity Gate - Where the certified pattern specifies a motif, repeat or visually material construction feature, imagery must faithfully depict it. The observed checkerboard-versus-diamond-lattice failure is a permanent regression fixture: matching category, colour, dimensions and lighting cannot rescue incorrect motif geometry.

requirements.title: Independent Dual Verdict
requirements.text: Before release, independently judge (A) PRODUCT TRUTH - does the image depict what the certified pattern actually makes? and (B) PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM - would the frame plausibly exist as an ordinary high-quality photograph without obvious generative artifacts? Both must pass. Never average them into one score.
requirements.full_text: Independent Dual Verdict - Before release, independently judge (A) PRODUCT TRUTH - does the image depict what the certified pattern actually makes? and (B) PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM - would the frame plausibly exist as an ordinary high-quality photograph without obvious generative artifacts? Both must pass. Never average them into one score.

requirements.title: Unreadable Is Not Pass
requirements.text: If stitch structure, motif, fit, anatomy or another required visual fact cannot be reliably assessed because of framing, distance, clothing, blur, pose or occlusion, return UNREADABLE/UNMEASURABLE for that dimension. Customer-facing release cannot treat absence of evidence as a pass.
requirements.full_text: Unreadable Is Not Pass - If stitch structure, motif, fit, anatomy or another required visual fact cannot be reliably assessed because of framing, distance, clothing, blur, pose or occlusion, return UNREADABLE/UNMEASURABLE for that dimension. Customer-facing release cannot treat absence of evidence as a pass.

requirements.title: Benchmark-Derived Photo Grammar
requirements.text: After the MJs teardown is legally purchased and ingested, quantify high-level gallery grammar such as image count/types, hero composition, close-up frequency, background/environment patterns, model-versus-product-only mix, lighting, framing and within-listing consistency. Store derived abstractions with provenance; competitor images remain source artifacts only.
requirements.full_text: Benchmark-Derived Photo Grammar - After the MJs teardown is legally purchased and ingested, quantify high-level gallery grammar such as image count/types, hero composition, close-up frequency, background/environment patterns, model-versus-product-only mix, lighting, framing and within-listing consistency. Store derived abstractions with provenance; competitor images remain source artifacts only.

requirements.title: Generated-Content Disclosure Integrity
requirements.text: Generated-image disclosure requirements remain authoritative. Photographic realism must never be achieved by concealing a material fact, fabricating proof, or representing generated imagery as real-world evidence when platform rules or Brambleloop policy require disclosure.
requirements.full_text: Generated-Content Disclosure Integrity - Generated-image disclosure requirements remain authoritative. Photographic realism must never be achieved by concealing a material fact, fabricating proof, or representing generated imagery as real-world evidence when platform rules or Brambleloop policy require disclosure.

requirements.title: Storefront Completion Gate
requirements.text: No paid traffic or public launch until icon, banner/cover where available, shop title/tagline, announcement, About, policies/FAQ, seller/public identity, sections, featured/ordered listings and coherent branding are complete. Blank/default surfaces block launch.
requirements.full_text: Storefront Completion Gate - No paid traffic or public launch until icon, banner/cover where available, shop title/tagline, announcement, About, policies/FAQ, seller/public identity, sections, featured/ordered listings and coherent branding are complete. Blank/default surfaces block launch.

requirements.title: Shop Trust Architecture
requirements.text: The shop clearly explains what Brambleloop sells, what the buyer receives, digital-delivery expectations, skill expectations, support path and policies without forcing buyers to infer them.
requirements.full_text: Shop Trust Architecture - The shop clearly explains what Brambleloop sells, what the buyer receives, digital-delivery expectations, skill expectations, support path and policies without forcing buyers to infer them.

requirements.title: About / Expertise / Process
requirements.text: Create a truthful, substantive About section and appropriate images/video showing Brambleloop's real process/quality system. Never invent years of experience, physical-making claims or credentials.
requirements.full_text: About / Expertise / Process - Create a truthful, substantive About section and appropriate images/video showing Brambleloop's real process/quality system. Never invent years of experience, physical-making claims or credentials.

requirements.title: Shop SEO Surface
requirements.text: Tagline and shop description use natural buyer language to explain the category/value proposition and support external search understanding without keyword stuffing.
requirements.full_text: Shop SEO Surface - Tagline and shop description use natural buyer language to explain the category/value proposition and support external search understanding without keyword stuffing.

requirements.title: Section Architecture
requirements.text: Sections reflect buyer browsing logic such as occasion, use/recipient and product family rather than opaque internal department names.
requirements.full_text: Section Architecture - Sections reflect buyer browsing logic such as occasion, use/recipient and product family rather than opaque internal department names.

requirements.title: Opening Grid Merchandising
requirements.text: Deliberately merchandise the first visible grid: strongest products first, seasonal opportunity visible, visual repetition controlled, price/value ladder apparent, and no weak legacy filler.
requirements.full_text: Opening Grid Merchandising - Deliberately merchandise the first visible grid: strongest products first, seasonal opportunity visible, visual repetition controlled, price/value ladder apparent, and no weak legacy filler.

requirements.title: Mobile Storefront QA
requirements.text: Before launch verify icon, banner crop, announcement opening, sections, first grid and thumbnails on mobile.
requirements.full_text: Mobile Storefront QA - Before launch verify icon, banner crop, announcement opening, sections, first grid and thumbnails on mobile.

requirements.title: Public Seller Identity Integrity
requirements.text: Approved public shop identity may differ from legal/tax presentation only where Etsy permits; legal, payout and tax identity remain truthful.
requirements.full_text: Public Seller Identity Integrity - Approved public shop identity may differ from legal/tax presentation only where Etsy permits; legal, payout and tax identity remain truthful.

requirements.title: Seasonal Storefront Takeover
requirements.text: Seasonal banner/announcement/featured-product changes have start/revert rules and never erase permanent Brambleloop identity.
requirements.full_text: Seasonal Storefront Takeover - Seasonal banner/announcement/featured-product changes have start/revert rules and never erase permanent Brambleloop identity.

requirements.title: Official Search Policy Snapshot
requirements.text: Maintain dated official Etsy search/search-visibility guidance. Material changes invalidate affected assumptions/certificates.
requirements.full_text: Official Search Policy Snapshot - Maintain dated official Etsy search/search-visibility guidance. Material changes invalidate affected assumptions/certificates.

requirements.title: Query-Matching Completeness
requirements.text: Each listing uses the most specific accurate category, relevant attributes, all 13 useful tags, clear title, useful description and truthful metadata.
requirements.full_text: Query-Matching Completeness - Each listing uses the most specific accurate category, relevant attributes, all 13 useful tags, clear title, useful description and truthful metadata.

requirements.title: Search Intent Graph
requirements.text: Map each product to buyer query families and corresponding category/attributes/title/tag/description coverage with provenance; avoid needless catalogue cannibalization.
requirements.full_text: Search Intent Graph - Map each product to buyer query families and corresponding category/attributes/title/tag/description coverage with provenance; avoid needless catalogue cannibalization.

requirements.title: Buyer-Friendly Title Gate
requirements.text: Titles clearly identify the item and meaningful differentiators while preserving relevant query coverage without stuffing or repetitive phrasing.
requirements.full_text: Buyer-Friendly Title Gate - Titles clearly identify the item and meaningful differentiators while preserving relevant query coverage without stuffing or repetitive phrasing.

requirements.title: Tag Diversity Gate
requirements.text: Use varied relevant tags, not near-duplicates. Seasonal terms must be truthful. Refresh from observed search terms/current evidence rather than fabricated demand.
requirements.full_text: Tag Diversity Gate - Use varied relevant tags, not near-duplicates. Seasonal terms must be truthful. Refresh from observed search terms/current evidence rather than fabricated demand.

requirements.title: Attribute / Category Integrity
requirements.text: Categories and attributes are maximally specific and accurate; traffic opportunity never justifies irrelevant metadata.
requirements.full_text: Attribute / Category Integrity - Categories and attributes are maximally specific and accurate; traffic opportunity never justifies irrelevant metadata.

requirements.title: Search Visibility Intake
requirements.text: Capture accessible Etsy Search Visibility recommendations with date, listing, shop/listing/service category, remediation and lifecycle. Code changes alone cannot mark them resolved.
requirements.full_text: Search Visibility Intake - Capture accessible Etsy Search Visibility recommendations with date, listing, shop/listing/service category, remediation and lifecycle. Code changes alone cannot mark them resolved.

requirements.title: Personalized-Ranking Humility
requirements.text: Manual searches of our own listings are not ranking proof. Use Shop Stats/Search Visibility/attributable traffic because Etsy results are personalized/context-specific.
requirements.full_text: Personalized-Ranking Humility - Manual searches of our own listings are not ranking proof. Use Shop Stats/Search Visibility/attributable traffic because Etsy results are personalized/context-specific.

requirements.title: Recency Non-Gaming
requirements.text: New/renewed listing boosts are temporary learning opportunities, not a renewal-spam strategy.
requirements.full_text: Recency Non-Gaming - New/renewed listing boosts are temporary learning opportunities, not a renewal-spam strategy.

requirements.title: Search Language Integrity
requirements.text: Titles/tags follow shop-language rules; translations are deliberate and not used as impression bait.
requirements.full_text: Search Language Integrity - Titles/tags follow shop-language rules; translations are deliberate and not used as impression bait.

requirements.title: First-Photo Click Gate
requirements.text: First image clearly shows the product, survives thumbnail/mobile crop, is high-resolution/well-lit, avoids confusing collage treatment and maximizes truthful click appeal.
requirements.full_text: First-Photo Click Gate - First image clearly shows the product, survives thumbnail/mobile crop, is high-resolution/well-lit, avoids confusing collage treatment and maximizes truthful click appeal.

requirements.title: Natural Photo + Product Truth
requirements.text: Final Master F-221-F-232 applies to every gallery: natural photographic realism and exact pattern/product fidelity are independent hard gates.
requirements.full_text: Natural Photo + Product Truth - Final Master F-221-F-232 applies to every gallery: natural photographic realism and exact pattern/product fidelity are independent hard gates.

requirements.title: Gallery Information Architecture
requirements.text: Gallery frames have jobs: hero, useful alternate angle, stitch/motif detail, scale/context, construction detail, colour context and fit/worn views where applicable.
requirements.full_text: Gallery Information Architecture - Gallery frames have jobs: hero, useful alternate angle, stitch/motif detail, scale/context, construction detail, colour context and fit/worn views where applicable.

requirements.title: Description Conversion Architecture
requirements.text: Descriptions lead with what is sold and why it matters, then skill level, result, sizing, materials, yarn/hook, gauge, inclusions, delivery, support/terms and decision-critical facts.
requirements.full_text: Description Conversion Architecture - Descriptions lead with what is sold and why it matters, then skill level, result, sizing, materials, yarn/hook, gauge, inclusions, delivery, support/terms and decision-critical facts.

requirements.title: Digital-Pattern Expectation Truth
requirements.text: Listings cannot imply a finished physical item when selling a digital pattern. Make the offer understandable before purchase without destroying visual appeal.
requirements.full_text: Digital-Pattern Expectation Truth - Listings cannot imply a finished physical item when selling a digital pattern. Make the offer understandable before purchase without destroying visual appeal.

requirements.title: Price / Value Coherence
requirements.text: Price, bundle, sale state and presentation tell one value story; fake anchors/permanent discounts/confusing jumps are refused.
requirements.full_text: Price / Value Coherence - Price, bundle, sale state and presentation tell one value story; fake anchors/permanent discounts/confusing jumps are refused.

requirements.title: Conversion Evidence Loop
requirements.text: Measure impressions -> clicks -> favorites -> orders where accessible. Diagnose visibility, click and conversion as different failure stages.
requirements.full_text: Conversion Evidence Loop - Measure impressions -> clicks -> favorites -> orders where accessible. Diagnose visibility, click and conversion as different failure stages.

requirements.title: Neutral New-Listing Prior
requirements.text: New listings begin UNMEASURED, not successful/failed. Update from exposure and engagement evidence.
requirements.full_text: Neutral New-Listing Prior - New listings begin UNMEASURED, not successful/failed. Update from exposure and engagement evidence.

requirements.title: Listing Experiment Discipline
requirements.text: Version controlled tests on meaningful variables preserve baseline/treatment windows and refuse conclusions without exposure.
requirements.full_text: Listing Experiment Discipline - Version controlled tests on meaningful variables preserve baseline/treatment windows and refuse conclusions without exposure.

requirements.title: Underperformer Remediation
requirements.text: No impressions -> relevance/query; impressions/no clicks -> hero/title/value; clicks/no sale -> product/value/trust/price; post-sale friction -> product/customer experience.
requirements.full_text: Underperformer Remediation - No impressions -> relevance/query; impressions/no clicks -> hero/title/value; clicks/no sale -> product/value/trust/price; post-sale friction -> product/customer experience.

requirements.title: Paid vs Organic Separation
requirements.text: Etsy Ads and organic search are measured separately. Ads do not directly improve organic placement outside designated ad spaces.
requirements.full_text: Paid vs Organic Separation - Etsy Ads and organic search are measured separately. Ads do not directly improve organic placement outside designated ad spaces.

requirements.title: Ads Launch Readiness Gate
requirements.text: Never buy traffic to unfinished storefronts or uncertified listings. Ads require storefront, listing truth, search, imagery, offer, policy and attribution readiness.
requirements.full_text: Ads Launch Readiness Gate - Never buy traffic to unfinished storefronts or uncertified listings. Ads require storefront, listing truth, search, imagery, offer, policy and attribution readiness.

requirements.title: Initial Etsy Ads Learning Test
requirements.text: Design launch testing consistent with current Etsy guidance: sufficient budget/duration to learn. Current Etsy guidance recommends at least US$3-5/day initially and, when practical, promoting all active listings to gather engagement data.
requirements.full_text: Initial Etsy Ads Learning Test - Design launch testing consistent with current Etsy guidance: sufficient budget/duration to learn. Current Etsy guidance recommends at least US$3-5/day initially and, when practical, promoting all active listings to gather engagement data.

requirements.title: Per-Listing Strategy Threshold
requirements.text: Recognize Etsy's current US$25/day maximum-budget threshold for per-listing strategies; below it do not pretend visibility/efficient/lower-click-cost controls are available.
requirements.full_text: Per-Listing Strategy Threshold - Recognize Etsy's current US$25/day maximum-budget threshold for per-listing strategies; below it do not pretend visibility/efficient/lower-click-cost controls are available.

requirements.title: Learning-Window Discipline
requirements.text: Avoid daily strategy thrash. Preserve meaningful optimization windows unless truth, safety, runaway spend or obviously invalid traffic requires intervention.
requirements.full_text: Learning-Window Discipline - Avoid daily strategy thrash. Preserve meaningful optimization windows unless truth, safety, runaway spend or obviously invalid traffic requires intervention.

requirements.title: Ad Budget Owner Authority
requirements.text: Advertising is consequential spend. New/increased ad ceilings require owner approval and are enforced before spend.
requirements.full_text: Ad Budget Owner Authority - Advertising is consequential spend. New/increased ad ceilings require owner approval and are enforced before spend.

requirements.title: Ad Allocation Evolution
requirements.text: Broad launch learning may narrow after evidence. Never cut unmeasured listings merely because null sorts below measured winners.
requirements.full_text: Ad Allocation Evolution - Broad launch learning may narrow after evidence. Never cut unmeasured listings merely because null sorts below measured winners.

requirements.title: Ad Funnel Attribution
requirements.text: Track spend, impressions, clicks, CPC, orders/revenue where accessible, conversion, contribution and evidence volume per advertised listing.
requirements.full_text: Ad Funnel Attribution - Track spend, impressions, clicks, CPC, orders/revenue where accessible, conversion, contribution and evidence volume per advertised listing.

requirements.title: Evidence-Aware Stop / Scale
requirements.text: Pause/continue/scale rules require adequate exposure. Spend with clicks/no conversion triggers diagnosis before more budget.
requirements.full_text: Evidence-Aware Stop / Scale - Pause/continue/scale rules require adequate exposure. Spend with clicks/no conversion triggers diagnosis before more budget.

requirements.title: Creative Before Spend Escalation
requirements.text: Impressions/weak clicks -> improve hero/title/value; healthy clicks/weak conversion -> diagnose product/listing/trust/price. Do not solve every problem with more budget.
requirements.full_text: Creative Before Spend Escalation - Impressions/weak clicks -> improve hero/title/value; healthy clicks/weak conversion -> diagnose product/listing/trust/price. Do not solve every problem with more budget.

requirements.title: Ads Cannot Rescue Bad Products
requirements.text: Ads never override Creative Standard, Pattern Truth, Asset Truth or customer-experience gates.
requirements.full_text: Ads Cannot Rescue Bad Products - Ads never override Creative Standard, Pattern Truth, Asset Truth or customer-experience gates.

requirements.title: Offsite Ads Accounting
requirements.text: Track Etsy Offsite Ads separately; account for attributed fees/economics without claiming control over which listings Etsy promotes.
requirements.full_text: Offsite Ads Accounting - Track Etsy Offsite Ads separately; account for attributed fees/economics without claiming control over which listings Etsy promotes.

requirements.title: Paid Experiment Ledger
requirements.text: Every campaign/change records objective, authorization, listings, budget, settings, window, evidence, verdict and rollback/next action.
requirements.full_text: Paid Experiment Ledger - Every campaign/change records objective, authorization, listings, budget, settings, window, evidence, verdict and rollback/next action.

requirements.title: Launch Demand Capture Plan
requirements.text: Before phase change link opening products to search intents, seasonal runway, storefront placement, organic readiness, Etsy Ads plan and measurement checkpoints.
requirements.full_text: Launch Demand Capture Plan - Before phase change link opening products to search intents, seasonal runway, storefront placement, organic readiness, Etsy Ads plan and measurement checkpoints.

requirements.title: Christmas Search Compression
requirements.text: Prepare Christmas query/title/tag/attribute/gallery/storefront/ad work early enough to collect engagement before peak buying; urgency cannot bypass truth/quality.
requirements.full_text: Christmas Search Compression - Prepare Christmas query/title/tag/attribute/gallery/storefront/ad work early enough to collect engagement before peak buying; urgency cannot bypass truth/quality.

requirements.title: Portfolio Query Coverage
requirements.text: Opening catalogue covers multiple relevant intents/product families rather than many listings fighting for one query.
requirements.full_text: Portfolio Query Coverage - Opening catalogue covers multiple relevant intents/product families rather than many listings fighting for one query.

requirements.title: Hero Thumbnail Tournament
requirements.text: Challenge first-photo candidates at Etsy-like thumbnail/mobile size; select for truthful clarity and click appeal, not full-resolution beauty.
requirements.full_text: Hero Thumbnail Tournament - Challenge first-photo candidates at Etsy-like thumbnail/mobile size; select for truthful clarity and click appeal, not full-resolution beauty.

requirements.title: Storefront-to-Listing Continuity
requirements.text: Banner, announcement, sections and featured products reinforce the same seasonal/value story as search/ad landing listings.
requirements.full_text: Storefront-to-Listing Continuity - Banner, announcement, sections and featured products reinforce the same seasonal/value story as search/ad landing listings.

requirements.title: Launch Search Visibility Watch
requirements.text: During launch week inspect accessible Search Visibility issues frequently enough to react quickly without evading unsanctioned surfaces.
requirements.full_text: Launch Search Visibility Watch - During launch week inspect accessible Search Visibility issues frequently enough to react quickly without evading unsanctioned surfaces.

requirements.title: First-30-Day Learning Plan
requirements.text: Predefine day 1/3/7/14/30 reviews of impressions, clicks, favorites, sales, conversion, search terms, ads, support friction and contribution.
requirements.full_text: First-30-Day Learning Plan - Predefine day 1/3/7/14/30 reviews of impressions, clicks, favorites, sales, conversion, search terms, ads, support friction and contribution.

requirements.title: No Zero-Sales Panic
requirements.text: Short early zero-sales windows require exposure diagnosis first; adequate qualified exposure with persistent no-conversion cannot be excused indefinitely as 'new shop'.
requirements.full_text: No Zero-Sales Panic - Short early zero-sales windows require exposure diagnosis first; adequate qualified exposure with persistent no-conversion cannot be excused indefinitely as 'new shop'.

requirements.title: First-Sale Attribution
requirements.text: Record first-sale source honestly (organic Etsy, Etsy Ads, Offsite Ads, owned/direct, unknown). One sale proves possibility, not scale.
requirements.full_text: First-Sale Attribution - Record first-sale source honestly (organic Etsy, Etsy Ads, Offsite Ads, owned/direct, unknown). One sale proves possibility, not scale.

requirements.title: Review / Service Flywheel
requirements.text: Prioritize flawless download, rapid truthful support and defect prevention. Reviews/response/case health feed trust/search; never buy or gate reviews.
requirements.full_text: Review / Service Flywheel - Prioritize flawless download, rapid truthful support and defect prevention. Reviews/response/case health feed trust/search; never buy or gate reviews.

requirements.title: Seasonal Keyword Refresh
requirements.text: Before major seasons refresh query/title/tag strategy from current Etsy guidance, Search Visibility, observed terms and market evidence.
requirements.full_text: Seasonal Keyword Refresh - Before major seasons refresh query/title/tag strategy from current Etsy guidance, Search Visibility, observed terms and market evidence.

requirements.title: Launch Success Multi-Signal
requirements.text: Launch success requires visibility + clicks + honest conversion + product truth + customer experience + unit economics, not merely 'live' or 'ads running'.
requirements.full_text: Launch Success Multi-Signal - Launch success requires visibility + clicks + honest conversion + product truth + customer experience + unit economics, not merely 'live' or 'ads running'.

requirements.title: Visibility Command Center
requirements.text: Dashboard shows storefront completion, Search Visibility issues, search readiness, search terms, impressions, clicks, conversion, ads, Offsite Ads, seasonal readiness and real owner actions.
requirements.full_text: Visibility Command Center - Dashboard shows storefront completion, Search Visibility issues, search readiness, search terms, impressions, clicks, conversion, ads, Offsite Ads, seasonal readiness and real owner actions.

requirements.title: Actionable Recommendations
requirements.text: Every search/ads recommendation names evidence, affected listings, expected mechanism, cost, confidence and rollback. 'Improve SEO' is not an action.
requirements.full_text: Actionable Recommendations - Every search/ads recommendation names evidence, affected listings, expected mechanism, cost, confidence and rollback. 'Improve SEO' is not an action.

requirements.title: Traffic Source Separation
requirements.text: UI separates Etsy organic, Etsy Ads, Offsite Ads and owned/direct traffic; blended totals never hide components.
requirements.full_text: Traffic Source Separation - UI separates Etsy organic, Etsy Ads, Offsite Ads and owned/direct traffic; blended totals never hide components.

requirements.title: Owner Ads Approval Cards
requirements.text: Ad authorization cards state daily/monthly ceiling, listings, objective, evidence, expected learning period, worst-case spend and consequence of waiting.
requirements.full_text: Owner Ads Approval Cards - Ad authorization cards state daily/monthly ceiling, listings, objective, evidence, expected learning period, worst-case spend and consequence of waiting.

requirements.title: Search / Ads Policy Watch
requirements.text: Re-fetch official Etsy search/ads guidance and invalidate assumptions when thresholds, controls or guidance change.
requirements.full_text: Search / Ads Policy Watch - Re-fetch official Etsy search/ads guidance and invalidate assumptions when thresholds, controls or guidance change.

requirements.title: No Vanity Optimization
requirements.text: Do not optimize raw impressions/clicks/favorites/content count/ad spend in isolation; prioritize qualified traffic, conversion, contribution, truth and customer experience.
requirements.full_text: No Vanity Optimization - Do not optimize raw impressions/clicks/favorites/content count/ad spend in isolation; prioritize qualified traffic, conversion, contribution, truth and customer experience.

requirements.title: Storefront Visual Inspection
requirements.text: Review complete BrambleloopStudio storefront at desktop/mobile before launch; no blank/default surfaces, stale identity, weak opening grid or seasonal mismatch.
requirements.full_text: Storefront Visual Inspection - Review complete BrambleloopStudio storefront at desktop/mobile before launch; no blank/default surfaces, stale identity, weak opening grid or seasonal mismatch.

requirements.title: Search Certificate Required
requirements.text: Opening listings require current search/truth/creative/conversion certification bound to exact content/image fingerprint; material edits invalidate affected checks.
requirements.full_text: Search Certificate Required - Opening listings require current search/truth/creative/conversion certification bound to exact content/image fingerprint; material edits invalidate affected checks.

requirements.title: Ads Dry Run
requirements.text: Simulate campaign plan before spend and prove uncertified listings, stale assets and over-budget actions cannot enter.
requirements.full_text: Ads Dry Run - Simulate campaign plan before spend and prove uncertified listings, stale assets and over-budget actions cannot enter.

requirements.title: Launch-Week Ad Envelope
requirements.text: Owner explicitly approves launch-week Etsy Ads ceiling separately from AI/infrastructure budgets.
requirements.full_text: Launch-Week Ad Envelope - Owner explicitly approves launch-week Etsy Ads ceiling separately from AI/infrastructure budgets.

requirements.title: Measurement Before Optimization
requirements.text: Prove accessible organic/paid evidence can be recorded before enabling automated optimization.
requirements.full_text: Measurement Before Optimization - Prove accessible organic/paid evidence can be recorded before enabling automated optimization.

requirements.title: No Visibility Shortcut
requirements.text: No misleading keyword, irrelevant attribute, renewal trick, clickbait image or ad tactic may bypass truth, IP/policy, product accuracy or customer experience.
requirements.full_text: No Visibility Shortcut - No misleading keyword, irrelevant attribute, renewal trick, clickbait image or ad tactic may bypass truth, IP/policy, product accuracy or customer experience.

requirements.title: Controlled Phase Change
requirements.text: Shadow -> staging -> live publication/ads is explicit owner-approved transition with rollback.
requirements.full_text: Controlled Phase Change - Shadow -> staging -> live publication/ads is explicit owner-approved transition with rollback.

requirements.title: Launch Readiness Verdict
requirements.text: Final challenge answers separately: Can buyers find it? Will they click? Does it convert honestly? Does the pattern make what is shown? Is the shop trustworthy? Are ads measurable/bounded? Any failed hard gate blocks launch.
requirements.full_text: Launch Readiness Verdict - Final challenge answers separately: Can buyers find it? Will they click? Does it convert honestly? Does the pattern make what is shown? Is the shop trustworthy? Are ads measurable/bounded? Any failed hard gate blocks launch.

requirements.title: Provider-Observed Spend Reconciliation
requirements.text: Internal spend is not authoritative by itself. Reconcile Brambleloop's ledger against actual provider-observed usage/cost for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, BFL and future paid providers. Unexplained variance is a trust blocker and must be surfaced, not silently absorbed.
requirements.full_text: Provider-Observed Spend Reconciliation - Internal spend is not authoritative by itself. Reconcile Brambleloop's ledger against actual provider-observed usage/cost for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, BFL and future paid providers. Unexplained variance is a trust blocker and must be surfaced, not silently absorbed.

requirements.title: Credits Are Not Budgets
requirements.text: Provider prepaid balance, credit purchase, account limit and Brambleloop spending authorization are four separate facts. Available provider credit never grants permission to spend beyond Brambleloop's owner-approved ceiling.
requirements.full_text: Credits Are Not Budgets - Provider prepaid balance, credit purchase, account limit and Brambleloop spending authorization are four separate facts. Available provider credit never grants permission to spend beyond Brambleloop's owner-approved ceiling.

requirements.title: Development vs Production Economics
requirements.text: Tag spend as development/build, benchmark/research, one-time product creation, listing/creative production, recurring production, support/operations, advertising-analysis, or other named purpose. One-time build burn must never be presented as steady-state operating cost.
requirements.full_text: Development vs Production Economics - Tag spend as development/build, benchmark/research, one-time product creation, listing/creative production, recurring production, support/operations, advertising-analysis, or other named purpose. One-time build burn must never be presented as steady-state operating cost.

requirements.title: Per-Operation Cost Attribution
requirements.text: Every paid call records provider, model, job/run, agent, product/listing where applicable, purpose, input/output usage or image count, estimated cost, actual/observed cost when available, timestamp and evidence produced.
requirements.full_text: Per-Operation Cost Attribution - Every paid call records provider, model, job/run, agent, product/listing where applicable, purpose, input/output usage or image count, estimated cost, actual/observed cost when available, timestamp and evidence produced.

requirements.title: Unattributed Spend Is a Defect
requirements.text: Every provider dollar must be attributable or explicitly placed in an unattributed bucket. Attributed + unattributed must reconcile to provider-observed spend. Unattributed spend above a defined tolerance raises an incident.
requirements.full_text: Unattributed Spend Is a Defect - Every provider dollar must be attributable or explicitly placed in an unattributed bucket. Attributed + unattributed must reconcile to provider-observed spend. Unattributed spend above a defined tolerance raises an incident.

requirements.title: No Duplicate Paid Evidence
requirements.text: Certified facts and valid observations are durable evidence. Never repay an LLM/vision model to judge identical evidence merely because a cadence runs again. Content/evidence fingerprints must make duplicate paid work idempotent.
requirements.full_text: No Duplicate Paid Evidence - Certified facts and valid observations are durable evidence. Never repay an LLM/vision model to judge identical evidence merely because a cadence runs again. Content/evidence fingerprints must make duplicate paid work idempotent.

requirements.title: Paid-Job Idempotency
requirements.text: Retries, deploys, worker restarts and concurrent claims cannot cause the same paid operation to execute twice without an explicit new evidence/version key. Reservation, execution and durable completion are transactionally linked where practical.
requirements.full_text: Paid-Job Idempotency - Retries, deploys, worker restarts and concurrent claims cannot cause the same paid operation to execute twice without an explicit new evidence/version key. Reservation, execution and durable completion are transactionally linked where practical.

requirements.title: Bounded Retry Economics
requirements.text: Every paid job has a bounded retry policy differentiated by failure type. Authentication/funding/configuration/content refusals do not enter generic transient retry loops. Retry storms are a financial-integrity incident.
requirements.full_text: Bounded Retry Economics - Every paid job has a bounded retry policy differentiated by failure type. Authentication/funding/configuration/content refusals do not enter generic transient retry loops. Retry storms are a financial-integrity incident.

requirements.title: Systematic-Failure Circuit Breaker
requirements.text: When repeated attempts fail the same hard floor across products/methods/providers strongly enough to indicate a systematic block, stop paid retries, name method_blocked_on, preserve evidence and require a changed method/provider/owner decision before spending again.
requirements.full_text: Systematic-Failure Circuit Breaker - When repeated attempts fail the same hard floor across products/methods/providers strongly enough to indicate a systematic block, stop paid retries, name method_blocked_on, preserve evidence and require a changed method/provider/owner decision before spending again.

requirements.title: New Evidence Requirement
requirements.text: A recurring paid cadence must produce new evidence or measurable state progress. Repeated cost without new durable evidence is detected as stalled/waste and automatically stops or escalates.
requirements.full_text: New Evidence Requirement - A recurring paid cadence must produce new evidence or measurable state progress. Repeated cost without new durable evidence is detected as stalled/waste and automatically stops or escalates.

requirements.title: Cache Certified Evidence
requirements.text: Pattern certificates, image judgments, identity verdicts, policy snapshots, benchmark observations and other stable evidence are cached/versioned and reused until an upstream fingerprint changes. Cache invalidation follows provenance, not elapsed time alone.
requirements.full_text: Cache Certified Evidence - Pattern certificates, image judgments, identity verdicts, policy snapshots, benchmark observations and other stable evidence are cached/versioned and reused until an upstream fingerprint changes. Cache invalidation follows provenance, not elapsed time alone.

requirements.title: Deterministic Before Generative
requirements.text: Use deterministic code, database queries, local computation or cached evidence when they can answer the question with equivalent correctness. Paid model calls are reserved for judgment/generation tasks that genuinely require them.
requirements.full_text: Deterministic Before Generative - Use deterministic code, database queries, local computation or cached evidence when they can answer the question with equivalent correctness. Paid model calls are reserved for judgment/generation tasks that genuinely require them.

requirements.title: Quality-Proven Model Routing
requirements.text: Route each task to the least expensive model/provider that has demonstrated equivalent performance on that task's required quality floors. Cost alone can never justify a downgrade. Quality-first routing decisions are evidence-backed and reversible.
requirements.full_text: Quality-Proven Model Routing - Route each task to the least expensive model/provider that has demonstrated equivalent performance on that task's required quality floors. Cost alone can never justify a downgrade. Quality-first routing decisions are evidence-backed and reversible.

requirements.title: Deep-Tier Escalation Policy
requirements.text: Expensive/deep models are escalation resources, not defaults. Define when Sonnet/Opus/deep judging is warranted, when a standard/cheap tier is sufficient, and when deterministic checks eliminate model use entirely.
requirements.full_text: Deep-Tier Escalation Policy - Expensive/deep models are escalation resources, not defaults. Define when Sonnet/Opus/deep judging is warranted, when a standard/cheap tier is sufficient, and when deterministic checks eliminate model use entirely.

requirements.title: Prompt/Input Token Discipline
requirements.text: Measure and control context size. Do not repeatedly send large unchanged histories, full catalogues or evidence bundles when a fingerprint, summary, retrieval slice or structured record suffices. Token reduction may not remove evidence required for correctness.
requirements.full_text: Prompt/Input Token Discipline - Measure and control context size. Do not repeatedly send large unchanged histories, full catalogues or evidence bundles when a fingerprint, summary, retrieval slice or structured record suffices. Token reduction may not remove evidence required for correctness.

requirements.title: Output Token Discipline
requirements.text: Model outputs use the minimum structured schema needed for the decision. Long narrative reasoning is not purchased where a compact verdict/evidence schema is sufficient. Truncation risk must still be prevented.
requirements.full_text: Output Token Discipline - Model outputs use the minimum structured schema needed for the decision. Long narrative reasoning is not purchased where a compact verdict/evidence schema is sufficient. Truncation risk must still be prevented.

requirements.title: Batching With Isolation
requirements.text: Batch model work only when it reduces cost without contaminating evidence between products/items. A batch failure cannot silently invalidate or duplicate-charge unrelated completed items.
requirements.full_text: Batching With Isolation - Batch model work only when it reduces cost without contaminating evidence between products/items. A batch failure cannot silently invalidate or duplicate-charge unrelated completed items.

requirements.title: Backlog Must Actually Drain
requirements.text: Any paid backlog processor reports unique pending before, unique completed, unique pending after and spend. Completion must durably reduce backlog. A cadence repeatedly processing the same items while backlog remains flat is a financial-integrity failure.
requirements.full_text: Backlog Must Actually Drain - Any paid backlog processor reports unique pending before, unique completed, unique pending after and spend. Completion must durably reduce backlog. A cadence repeatedly processing the same items while backlog remains flat is a financial-integrity failure.

requirements.title: Spend-to-Progress Ratio
requirements.text: Track cost per new durable evidence unit and cost per requirement/product/listing advanced. Large spend with little new evidence triggers investigation even when the monthly ceiling has not been reached.
requirements.full_text: Spend-to-Progress Ratio - Track cost per new durable evidence unit and cost per requirement/product/listing advanced. Large spend with little new evidence triggers investigation even when the monthly ceiling has not been reached.

requirements.title: Per-Product Creation Cost
requirements.text: For every sellable pattern, compute total one-time creation cost across concept/research, pattern engineering, certification, imagery, listing creation and necessary judging. Preserve provider/model breakdown and distinguish sunk development infrastructure.
requirements.full_text: Per-Product Creation Cost - For every sellable pattern, compute total one-time creation cost across concept/research, pattern engineering, certification, imagery, listing creation and necessary judging. Preserve provider/model breakdown and distinguish sunk development infrastructure.

requirements.title: Per-Listing Maintenance Cost
requirements.text: Track recurring AI/API cost attributable to each live listing: observation, revalidation, seasonal refresh, support intelligence and other maintenance. Stable listings should approach very low recurring inference cost.
requirements.full_text: Per-Listing Maintenance Cost - Track recurring AI/API cost attributable to each live listing: observation, revalidation, seasonal refresh, support intelligence and other maintenance. Stable listings should approach very low recurring inference cost.

requirements.title: Cost Per Usable Asset
requirements.text: For generated imagery record attempts, failures, accepted assets, generation cost, judging cost and cost per completely usable asset/gallery. A low first-pass rate cannot be hidden behind one successful render.
requirements.full_text: Cost Per Usable Asset - For generated imagery record attempts, failures, accepted assets, generation cost, judging cost and cost per completely usable asset/gallery. A low first-pass rate cannot be hidden behind one successful render.

requirements.title: Cost Per Sale / Contribution
requirements.text: Where attribution permits, calculate revenue minus Etsy fees, advertising, refunds, variable AI/API cost and other variable costs. AI cost is part of contribution economics, not an infrastructure footnote.
requirements.full_text: Cost Per Sale / Contribution - Where attribution permits, calculate revenue minus Etsy fees, advertising, refunds, variable AI/API cost and other variable costs. AI cost is part of contribution economics, not an infrastructure footnote.

requirements.title: Break-Even Sales Requirement
requirements.text: For each product estimate how many sales are required to recover one-time product creation cost, then distinguish that from recurring margin. High-quality one-time creation spend can be rational if the reusable digital product has strong lifetime economics.
requirements.full_text: Break-Even Sales Requirement - For each product estimate how many sales are required to recover one-time product creation cost, then distinguish that from recurring margin. High-quality one-time creation spend can be rational if the reusable digital product has strong lifetime economics.

requirements.title: Steady-State Sustainability Forecast
requirements.text: Forecast monthly AI/API cost at realistic catalogue sizes, sales volumes, support loads and observation cadences. Include low/base/high cases and name assumptions. Refuse a precise forecast when operational data is insufficient.
requirements.full_text: Steady-State Sustainability Forecast - Forecast monthly AI/API cost at realistic catalogue sizes, sales volumes, support loads and observation cadences. Include low/base/high cases and name assumptions. Refuse a precise forecast when operational data is insufficient.

requirements.title: Provider Spend Anomaly Detection
requirements.text: Detect abnormal daily/hourly burn relative to measured baseline and workload. Alert on sudden token/image spikes, repeated identical purposes, unexpected expensive-model routing, backlog loops and provider/internal ledger divergence.
requirements.full_text: Provider Spend Anomaly Detection - Detect abnormal daily/hourly burn relative to measured baseline and workload. Alert on sudden token/image spikes, repeated identical purposes, unexpected expensive-model routing, backlog loops and provider/internal ledger divergence.

requirements.title: Hard Spend Reservations
requirements.text: Consequential paid jobs reserve expected budget before execution and settle actual cost afterward. A job cannot begin when its reservation would exceed the applicable owner-authorized ceiling.
requirements.full_text: Hard Spend Reservations - Consequential paid jobs reserve expected budget before execution and settle actual cost afterward. A job cannot begin when its reservation would exceed the applicable owner-authorized ceiling.

requirements.title: No Spend To Look Busy
requirements.text: Autonomous agents/cadences may not consume paid inference merely because they are scheduled or READY. Every paid call must answer a specific unresolved question, produce new evidence, create a required asset, or perform necessary live work.
requirements.full_text: No Spend To Look Busy - Autonomous agents/cadences may not consume paid inference merely because they are scheduled or READY. Every paid call must answer a specific unresolved question, produce new evidence, create a required asset, or perform necessary live work.

requirements.title: Sustainability Launch Gate
requirements.text: Before launch, demonstrate estimated steady-state Brambleloop economics are commercially sustainable at opening prices. If expected recurring AI/API cost threatens product contribution or requires constant owner top-ups unrelated to sales, launch is blocked until corrected.
requirements.full_text: Sustainability Launch Gate - Before launch, demonstrate estimated steady-state Brambleloop economics are commercially sustainable at opening prices. If expected recurring AI/API cost threatens product contribution or requires constant owner top-ups unrelated to sales, launch is blocked until corrected.

requirements.title: Post-Launch Cost Learning
requirements.text: After launch review actual unit economics at day 1/7/14/30 and thereafter. Optimize waste aggressively while preserving Pattern Truth, Product Truth, photographic realism, customer experience and other quality floors. Never cheapen the product to make a cost dashboard green.
requirements.full_text: Post-Launch Cost Learning - After launch review actual unit economics at day 1/7/14/30 and thereafter. Optimize waste aggressively while preserving Pattern Truth, Product Truth, photographic realism, customer experience and other quality floors. Never cheapen the product to make a cost dashboard green.

requirements.title: Authoritative Job Identity
requirements.text: Every long-running operation receives a durable unique job/run ID. Consumers observe that ID and its persisted state/result rather than rediscovering work by fuzzy process-name matching.
requirements.full_text: Authoritative Job Identity - Every long-running operation receives a durable unique job/run ID. Consumers observe that ID and its persisted state/result rather than rediscovering work by fuzzy process-name matching.

requirements.title: No Self-Matching Liveness Probe
requirements.text: A liveness/progress probe must be structurally incapable of matching its own observer/waiter process. Process-signature searches such as pgrep/grep are prohibited as authoritative evidence unless self-exclusion and target identity are proven.
requirements.full_text: No Self-Matching Liveness Probe - A liveness/progress probe must be structurally incapable of matching its own observer/waiter process. Process-signature searches such as pgrep/grep are prohibited as authoritative evidence unless self-exclusion and target identity are proven.

requirements.title: One Operation, One State
requirements.text: Multiple agents, dashboards or waiters observing the same operation must subscribe/read the same authoritative state. They may not spawn duplicate underlying operations or independent chains of waiters merely to learn completion.
requirements.full_text: One Operation, One State - Multiple agents, dashboards or waiters observing the same operation must subscribe/read the same authoritative state. They may not spawn duplicate underlying operations or independent chains of waiters merely to learn completion.

requirements.title: Waiter Deduplication
requirements.text: At most one active waiter/monitor is created for a given job when a waiter is required. Duplicate wait requests attach to the existing monitor or read durable state; duplicate waiters are detected and terminated safely.
requirements.full_text: Waiter Deduplication - At most one active waiter/monitor is created for a given job when a waiter is required. Duplicate wait requests attach to the existing monitor or read durable state; duplicate waiters are detected and terminated safely.

requirements.title: Completion Is Durable
requirements.text: Completion, failure, cancellation, timeout and result/evidence are persisted independently of the observer session. A completed job cannot remain 'running' merely because an observer missed the terminal event.
requirements.full_text: Completion Is Durable - Completion, failure, cancellation, timeout and result/evidence are persisted independently of the observer session. A completed job cannot remain 'running' merely because an observer missed the terminal event.

requirements.title: Progress Must Be Work-Derived
requirements.text: Progress comes from the underlying workload: completed/total units, durable checkpoints, output timestamps or explicit stage transitions. Observer count, poll count, process count, elapsed time and number of waiters are never evidence of workload progress.
requirements.full_text: Progress Must Be Work-Derived - Progress comes from the underlying workload: completed/total units, durable checkpoints, output timestamps or explicit stage transitions. Observer count, poll count, process count, elapsed time and number of waiters are never evidence of workload progress.

requirements.title: Expected-Duration Watchdog
requirements.text: Track rolling normal duration by operation class. When runtime materially exceeds the established envelope (default investigation threshold 3x rolling normal where enough history exists), verify authoritative job state before continuing to wait, restart or escalate.
requirements.full_text: Expected-Duration Watchdog - Track rolling normal duration by operation class. When runtime materially exceeds the established envelope (default investigation threshold 3x rolling normal where enough history exists), verify authoritative job state before continuing to wait, restart or escalate.

requirements.title: Non-Destructive Hang Diagnosis
requirements.text: Before killing/restarting a long-running operation, determine whether it is alive, advancing, completed-but-unobserved, blocked on a child/dependency, or duplicated. Preserve valid output and evidence already produced.
requirements.full_text: Non-Destructive Hang Diagnosis - Before killing/restarting a long-running operation, determine whether it is alive, advancing, completed-but-unobserved, blocked on a child/dependency, or duplicated. Preserve valid output and evidence already produced.

requirements.title: No Blind Restart
requirements.text: A slow or apparently stuck operation is not rerun until the prior operation's authoritative state is known. Restart/retry must not duplicate paid calls, mutate shared state twice, or discard a valid completed result.
requirements.full_text: No Blind Restart - A slow or apparently stuck operation is not rerun until the prior operation's authoritative state is known. Restart/retry must not duplicate paid calls, mutate shared state twice, or discard a valid completed result.

requirements.title: Waiter Resource Bound
requirements.text: Waiting/monitoring has bounded wall time, process count and resource use. On bound breach, stop spawning observers and escalate to authoritative-state diagnosis; do not let a monitoring defect consume hours unattended.
requirements.full_text: Waiter Resource Bound - Waiting/monitoring has bounded wall time, process count and resource use. On bound breach, stop spawning observers and escalate to authoritative-state diagnosis; do not let a monitoring defect consume hours unattended.

requirements.title: Result Propagation Contract
requirements.text: The producer writes a terminal result exactly once and all consumers read that result. Result propagation is tested across shell exit, agent interruption, deploy/restart and delayed observers.
requirements.full_text: Result Propagation Contract - The producer writes a terminal result exactly once and all consumers read that result. Result propagation is tested across shell exit, agent interruption, deploy/restart and delayed observers.

requirements.title: Observer/Work Separation
requirements.text: Monitoring code and workload code are separately identifiable in process/job metadata. A query for the workload cannot be satisfied by the observer itself, its parent shell, or another monitoring process.
requirements.full_text: Observer/Work Separation - Monitoring code and workload code are separately identifiable in process/job metadata. A query for the workload cannot be satisfied by the observer itself, its parent shell, or another monitoring process.

requirements.title: No False Healthy/Busy State
requirements.text: Health dashboards must distinguish 'work executing', 'work completed', 'observer waiting', 'blocked', and 'unknown'. A waiter being alive cannot make the system healthy, busy, progressing or non-idle.
requirements.full_text: No False Healthy/Busy State - Health dashboards must distinguish 'work executing', 'work completed', 'observer waiting', 'blocked', and 'unknown'. A waiter being alive cannot make the system healthy, busy, progressing or non-idle.

requirements.title: Operational Time Waste Accounting
requirements.text: Record avoidable wall-clock delay caused by orchestration/observer defects separately from compute/API spend. Large time loss without business progress is a reliability incident even when monetary spend is zero.
requirements.full_text: Operational Time Waste Accounting - Record avoidable wall-clock delay caused by orchestration/observer defects separately from compute/API spend. Large time loss without business progress is a reliability incident even when monetary spend is zero.

requirements.title: Test-Suite Run Record
requirements.text: Each full acceptance suite persists start time, end time, commit/SHA, total tests, pass/fail/skip counts, duration and log/result location. The latest validated suite is queryable without inspecting shell processes.
requirements.full_text: Test-Suite Run Record - Each full acceptance suite persists start time, end time, commit/SHA, total tests, pass/fail/skip counts, duration and log/result location. The latest validated suite is queryable without inspecting shell processes.

requirements.title: Suite Concurrency Guard
requirements.text: Only one full suite for the same commit/environment may run unless deliberate parallel execution is explicitly requested. Additional requests attach to/read the existing run.
requirements.full_text: Suite Concurrency Guard - Only one full suite for the same commit/environment may run unless deliberate parallel execution is explicitly requested. Additional requests attach to/read the existing run.

requirements.title: Targeted Validation Before Full Rerun
requirements.text: After diagnosing a hang/observer defect, validate the smallest affected test/module first. Run the full suite only when needed to prove integration, preventing long redundant validation loops.
requirements.full_text: Targeted Validation Before Full Rerun - After diagnosing a hang/observer defect, validate the smallest affected test/module first. Run the full suite only when needed to prove integration, preventing long redundant validation loops.

requirements.title: Monitor Regression Tests
requirements.text: Automated tests must prove: observers cannot match themselves; duplicate waiters do not multiply; completed jobs are observed as complete; stale observers cannot resurrect running state; and rising observer counts cannot be interpreted as progress.
requirements.full_text: Monitor Regression Tests - Automated tests must prove: observers cannot match themselves; duplicate waiters do not multiply; completed jobs are observed as complete; stale observers cannot resurrect running state; and rising observer counts cannot be interpreted as progress.

requirements.title: Business-Progress Preservation
requirements.text: Monitoring, testing and orchestration may not monopolize autonomous work when independent zero-cost launch-critical work can safely proceed. Concurrency is allowed only where shared-state integrity remains protected.
requirements.full_text: Business-Progress Preservation - Monitoring, testing and orchestration may not monopolize autonomous work when independent zero-cost launch-critical work can safely proceed. Concurrency is allowed only where shared-state integrity remains protected.

requirements.title: Reliability Incident Escalation
requirements.text: Any observer defect that creates false progress, hides completion, duplicates work, or causes material launch delay is logged as a reliability/trust incident with root cause, prevention test and durable fix before closure.
requirements.full_text: Reliability Incident Escalation - Any observer defect that creates false progress, hides completion, duplicates work, or causes material launch delay is logged as a reliability/trust incident with root cause, prevention test and durable fix before closure.

requirements.title: Priority Product Family
requirements.text: Baby and children's crochet patterns are a high-priority Brambleloop product family for market research, launch planning, catalogue expansion and seasonal planning.
requirements.full_text: Priority Product Family - Baby and children's crochet patterns are a high-priority Brambleloop product family for market research, launch planning, catalogue expansion and seasonal planning.

requirements.title: Evidence-Led Selection
requirements.text: Priority status does not mean blind production. Product selection must still use Brambleloop's demand, competition, pricing, differentiation, seasonality and launch-readiness evidence.
requirements.full_text: Evidence-Led Selection - Priority status does not mean blind production. Product selection must still use Brambleloop's demand, competition, pricing, differentiation, seasonality and launch-readiness evidence.

requirements.title: Core Category Coverage
requirements.text: Research newborn/baby cardigans, toddler/children's cardigans, sweaters, jackets, dresses, tops/vests, hooded pieces, matching sets, bonnets/hats, decorative collars, blankets, seasonal/holiday garments, unisex designs and sibling/multi-size products.
requirements.full_text: Core Category Coverage - Research newborn/baby cardigans, toddler/children's cardigans, sweaters, jackets, dresses, tops/vests, hooded pieces, matching sets, bonnets/hats, decorative collars, blankets, seasonal/holiday garments, unisex designs and sibling/multi-size products.

requirements.title: Multi-Size Value
requirements.text: Explicitly evaluate products that include multiple age/size ranges in one purchase. Measure customer value, search demand, grading complexity, support burden and conversion potential rather than automatically splitting every size into separate listings.
