requirements.full_text: Multi-Size Value - Explicitly evaluate products that include multiple age/size ranges in one purchase. Measure customer value, search demand, grading complexity, support burden and conversion potential rather than automatically splitting every size into separate listings.

requirements.title: Beginner-Friendly Opportunity
requirements.text: Measure demand for easy/beginner-friendly children's construction and identify designs that can remain visually distinctive while reducing instruction complexity and failure risk.
requirements.full_text: Beginner-Friendly Opportunity - Measure demand for easy/beginner-friendly children's construction and identify designs that can remain visually distinctive while reducing instruction complexity and failure risk.

requirements.title: Gift Intent
requirements.text: Model baby-shower, newborn-gift, birthday, holiday and handmade-gift purchase intent when selecting and merchandising children's products.
requirements.full_text: Gift Intent - Model baby-shower, newborn-gift, birthday, holiday and handmade-gift purchase intent when selecting and merchandising children's products.

requirements.title: Seasonality
requirements.text: Track seasonal demand for children's garments and accessories early enough that research, pattern certification, imagery, listing preparation and launch occur before the demand window.
requirements.full_text: Seasonality - Track seasonal demand for children's garments and accessories early enough that research, pattern certification, imagery, listing preparation and launch occur before the demand window.

requirements.title: Gender-Neutral & Style Segments
requirements.text: Research gender-neutral as well as style-specific demand. Do not infer a fixed palette or aesthetic; use marketplace evidence and Brambleloop's creative differentiation system.
requirements.full_text: Gender-Neutral & Style Segments - Research gender-neutral as well as style-specific demand. Do not infer a fixed palette or aesthetic; use marketplace evidence and Brambleloop's creative differentiation system.

requirements.title: Sibling / Family Variants
requirements.text: Evaluate sibling sets, coordinated products and reusable design families where genuine customer value exists, while preventing low-value catalogue duplication.
requirements.full_text: Sibling / Family Variants - Evaluate sibling sets, coordinated products and reusable design families where genuine customer value exists, while preventing low-value catalogue duplication.

requirements.title: Sizing Is Safety-Critical Product Truth
requirements.text: Children's sizing, gauge, finished measurements, ease and age/size labeling must be validated with the same or stronger Product Truth discipline as adult garments. Smaller garments do not justify weaker validation.
requirements.full_text: Sizing Is Safety-Critical Product Truth - Children's sizing, gauge, finished measurements, ease and age/size labeling must be validated with the same or stronger Product Truth discipline as adult garments. Smaller garments do not justify weaker validation.

requirements.title: No Lower Quality Floor
requirements.text: Children's products must clear the same instruction clarity, stitch/count consistency, construction plausibility, image truth, download integrity and customer-support readiness floors as the rest of the catalogue.
requirements.full_text: No Lower Quality Floor - Children's products must clear the same instruction clarity, stitch/count consistency, construction plausibility, image truth, download integrity and customer-support readiness floors as the rest of the catalogue.

requirements.title: Age-Range Clarity
requirements.text: Listings and PDFs must state supported size/age ranges and finished measurements clearly. Avoid implying that age alone guarantees fit where measurements are the authoritative basis.
requirements.full_text: Age-Range Clarity - Listings and PDFs must state supported size/age ranges and finished measurements clearly. Avoid implying that age alone guarantees fit where measurements are the authoritative basis.

requirements.title: Physical Plausibility
requirements.text: Wearables for babies/children require explicit checks for proportion, openings, closures, seams, trim and construction details that could make the finished object impractical or inconsistent with the certified pattern.
requirements.full_text: Physical Plausibility - Wearables for babies/children require explicit checks for proportion, openings, closures, seams, trim and construction details that could make the finished object impractical or inconsistent with the certified pattern.

requirements.title: Visual Merchandising
requirements.text: Children's listing imagery and storefront presentation should optimize emotional/gifting appeal while remaining truthful to the certified product. Product Truth cannot be traded for cuteness or conversion.
requirements.full_text: Visual Merchandising - Children's listing imagery and storefront presentation should optimize emotional/gifting appeal while remaining truthful to the certified product. Product Truth cannot be traded for cuteness or conversion.

requirements.title: Store Architecture
requirements.text: Brambleloop's storefront taxonomy must support a coherent Baby & Kids department/collection when catalogue depth justifies it, including useful navigation by garment/product family and size/age range where supported.
requirements.full_text: Store Architecture - Brambleloop's storefront taxonomy must support a coherent Baby & Kids department/collection when catalogue depth justifies it, including useful navigation by garment/product family and size/age range where supported.

requirements.title: Launch Mix Evaluation
requirements.text: Once the Product Truth/image architecture is resolved, the launch-catalogue optimizer must explicitly consider baby/children's products alongside adult garments, home/decor, seasonal and accessories rather than treating kids as a later afterthought.
requirements.full_text: Launch Mix Evaluation - Once the Product Truth/image architecture is resolved, the launch-catalogue optimizer must explicitly consider baby/children's products alongside adult garments, home/decor, seasonal and accessories rather than treating kids as a later afterthought.

requirements.title: Competitive Learning
requirements.text: Successful children's crochet shops and listings may be studied for demand signals, product families, merchandising, pricing, bundling, sizing strategies and customer expectations. Brambleloop must use that evidence to make its own product decisions.
requirements.full_text: Competitive Learning - Successful children's crochet shops and listings may be studied for demand signals, product families, merchandising, pricing, bundling, sizing strategies and customer expectations. Brambleloop must use that evidence to make its own product decisions.

requirements.title: Differentiation Requirement
requirements.text: Do not fill the catalogue with undifferentiated near-duplicates merely because the category is popular. Each selected product must justify its place through demand, differentiation, bundle value, seasonality or strategic catalogue coverage.
requirements.full_text: Differentiation Requirement - Do not fill the catalogue with undifferentiated near-duplicates merely because the category is popular. Each selected product must justify its place through demand, differentiation, bundle value, seasonality or strategic catalogue coverage.

requirements.title: Portfolio Measurement
requirements.text: Track children's-category impressions, clicks, favourites, conversion, revenue, refunds/support burden, seasonality and repeat-customer behaviour separately enough to learn whether priority should increase or decrease after launch.
requirements.full_text: Portfolio Measurement - Track children's-category impressions, clicks, favourites, conversion, revenue, refunds/support burden, seasonality and repeat-customer behaviour separately enough to learn whether priority should increase or decrease after launch.

requirements.title: Autonomous Rebalancing
requirements.text: After sufficient live evidence exists, Brambleloop may increase or reduce the share of baby/children's products based on measured performance, while preserving owner-set brand and quality constraints.
requirements.full_text: Autonomous Rebalancing - After sufficient live evidence exists, Brambleloop may increase or reduce the share of baby/children's products based on measured performance, while preserving owner-set brand and quality constraints.

requirements.title: 24/7 Cloud Operation
requirements.text: Production workers, scheduler/cadences, durable queues, observation, incident detection, spend governance and authorized business operations continue in cloud infrastructure while the owner PC is completely off.
requirements.full_text: 24/7 Cloud Operation - Production workers, scheduler/cadences, durable queues, observation, incident detection, spend governance and authorized business operations continue in cloud infrastructure while the owner PC is completely off.

requirements.title: Continuous Improvement Loop
requirements.text: Brambleloop continuously searches for evidence-backed improvements across products, patterns, CIR/digital twins, PDFs, imagery, storefront, Etsy search, conversion, pricing, ads, support, costs, seasonality and internal reliability.
requirements.full_text: Continuous Improvement Loop - Brambleloop continuously searches for evidence-backed improvements across products, patterns, CIR/digital twins, PDFs, imagery, storefront, Etsy search, conversion, pricing, ads, support, costs, seasonality and internal reliability.

requirements.title: Evidence Before Change
requirements.text: No autonomous improvement is deployed merely because an agent proposes it. Every material change requires evidence of the problem/opportunity, a defined hypothesis and measurable acceptance criteria.
requirements.full_text: Evidence Before Change - No autonomous improvement is deployed merely because an agent proposes it. Every material change requires evidence of the problem/opportunity, a defined hypothesis and measurable acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Isolated Experimentation
requirements.text: Potential improvements are tested in shadow/staging/isolated work before production adoption. Experiments cannot silently mutate the production truth they are intended to evaluate.
requirements.full_text: Isolated Experimentation - Potential improvements are tested in shadow/staging/isolated work before production adoption. Experiments cannot silently mutate the production truth they are intended to evaluate.

requirements.title: Champion-Challenger
requirements.text: Where measurable, compare the proposed version against the current production champion. The challenger replaces the champion only after satisfying all applicable hard floors and demonstrating the intended improvement.
requirements.full_text: Champion-Challenger - Where measurable, compare the proposed version against the current production champion. The challenger replaces the champion only after satisfying all applicable hard floors and demonstrating the intended improvement.

requirements.title: Hard Floors Cannot Be Optimized Away
requirements.text: Pattern Truth, Product Truth, identity/morphology, photographic realism, IP/policy, customer experience, financial controls and other hard gates cannot be averaged away by higher conversion, lower cost or another favorable metric.
requirements.full_text: Hard Floors Cannot Be Optimized Away - Pattern Truth, Product Truth, identity/morphology, photographic realism, IP/policy, customer experience, financial controls and other hard gates cannot be averaged away by higher conversion, lower cost or another favorable metric.

requirements.title: Durable Learning
requirements.text: Validated findings become durable structured knowledge, provenance, regression fixtures, tests or capability changes so Brambleloop does not repeatedly pay to rediscover the same lesson.
requirements.full_text: Durable Learning - Validated findings become durable structured knowledge, provenance, regression fixtures, tests or capability changes so Brambleloop does not repeatedly pay to rediscover the same lesson.

requirements.title: Failure Memory
requirements.text: Known failed methods/providers/prompts/architectures are fingerprinted with the evidence that rejected them. They are not retried without a materially changed premise or new evidence.
requirements.full_text: Failure Memory - Known failed methods/providers/prompts/architectures are fingerprinted with the evidence that rejected them. They are not retried without a materially changed premise or new evidence.

requirements.title: Self-Improvement Is Bounded
requirements.text: Brambleloop may autonomously improve within owner-authorized boundaries but may not grant itself new authority, raise spending ceilings, bypass owner gates, publish outside the active phase, or weaken controls to make progress.
requirements.full_text: Self-Improvement Is Bounded - Brambleloop may autonomously improve within owner-authorized boundaries but may not grant itself new authority, raise spending ceilings, bypass owner gates, publish outside the active phase, or weaken controls to make progress.

requirements.title: Code Change Governance
requirements.text: Autonomous code changes require tests, version control, deploy evidence, rollback capability and post-deploy observation appropriate to their blast radius. Production self-modification is never an unversioned live edit.
requirements.full_text: Code Change Governance - Autonomous code changes require tests, version control, deploy evidence, rollback capability and post-deploy observation appropriate to their blast radius. Production self-modification is never an unversioned live edit.

requirements.title: Rollback First-Class
requirements.text: Every material autonomous deployment preserves a known-good predecessor and an executable rollback/recovery path. Detected regression triggers containment and rollback according to severity.
requirements.full_text: Rollback First-Class - Every material autonomous deployment preserves a known-good predecessor and an executable rollback/recovery path. Detected regression triggers containment and rollback according to severity.

requirements.title: Maturity Ladder
requirements.text: Track implemented → tested → deployed → exercised → evidenced → production-observed as distinct states. An improvement cannot be described as production-proven at an earlier maturity level.
requirements.full_text: Maturity Ladder - Track implemented → tested → deployed → exercised → evidenced → production-observed as distinct states. An improvement cannot be described as production-proven at an earlier maturity level.

requirements.title: Business Outcome Learning
requirements.text: The system learns from impressions, clicks, favourites, carts, sales, refunds, support, reviews, contribution margin and repeat behavior where available, while distinguishing correlation from demonstrated causal experiment evidence.
requirements.full_text: Business Outcome Learning - The system learns from impressions, clicks, favourites, carts, sales, refunds, support, reviews, contribution margin and repeat behavior where available, while distinguishing correlation from demonstrated causal experiment evidence.

requirements.title: Product Portfolio Learning
requirements.text: Continuously evaluate which product families, skill levels, sizes, seasons, price points and bundles deserve more or less catalogue investment using measured market and customer evidence.
requirements.full_text: Product Portfolio Learning - Continuously evaluate which product families, skill levels, sizes, seasons, price points and bundles deserve more or less catalogue investment using measured market and customer evidence.

requirements.title: Pattern-System Learning
requirements.text: Defects, tester evidence, support issues, benchmark teardowns and real-product reconstruction findings feed improvements to pattern generation, CIR semantics, grading, charts, instructions and certification.
requirements.full_text: Pattern-System Learning - Defects, tester evidence, support issues, benchmark teardowns and real-product reconstruction findings feed improvements to pattern generation, CIR semantics, grading, charts, instructions and certification.

requirements.title: Visual-System Learning
requirements.text: Listing imagery learns from Product Truth failures, realism failures, click-through/conversion evidence and approved benchmark photography without allowing conversion optimization to alter the certified product.
requirements.full_text: Visual-System Learning - Listing imagery learns from Product Truth failures, realism failures, click-through/conversion evidence and approved benchmark photography without allowing conversion optimization to alter the certified product.

requirements.title: Etsy Search Learning
requirements.text: Search terms, Search Visibility guidance, impressions, clicks and conversions continuously inform titles, tags, attributes, sections and merchandising through controlled/versioned changes.
requirements.full_text: Etsy Search Learning - Search terms, Search Visibility guidance, impressions, clicks and conversions continuously inform titles, tags, attributes, sections and merchandising through controlled/versioned changes.

requirements.title: Ads Learning
requirements.text: Paid-media allocation learns from attributable performance and contribution economics inside owner-approved ceilings; it cannot raise its own ad budget or use paid traffic to conceal weak organic/listing quality.
requirements.full_text: Ads Learning - Paid-media allocation learns from attributable performance and contribution economics inside owner-approved ceilings; it cannot raise its own ad budget or use paid traffic to conceal weak organic/listing quality.

requirements.title: Cost Learning
requirements.text: Provider/model routing, context size, caching, deterministic substitutions and cadence frequency continuously improve cost efficiency, but cheaper execution must prove equivalent required quality before adoption.
requirements.full_text: Cost Learning - Provider/model routing, context size, caching, deterministic substitutions and cadence frequency continuously improve cost efficiency, but cheaper execution must prove equivalent required quality before adoption.

requirements.title: Seasonal Learning
requirements.text: Seasonal performance and lead-time evidence update future research, design, certification, merchandising and advertising schedules so the system improves timing each cycle.
requirements.full_text: Seasonal Learning - Seasonal performance and lead-time evidence update future research, design, certification, merchandising and advertising schedules so the system improves timing each cycle.

requirements.title: Customer Feedback Learning
requirements.text: Support questions, complaints, refunds, reviews and recurring confusion are converted into structured product/process evidence. Customer feedback may trigger fixes but does not automatically override validated product truth.
requirements.full_text: Customer Feedback Learning - Support questions, complaints, refunds, reviews and recurring confusion are converted into structured product/process evidence. Customer feedback may trigger fixes but does not automatically override validated product truth.

requirements.title: Incident Learning
requirements.text: Every meaningful reliability, spend, evidence or customer-impact incident produces root cause, durable prevention, regression coverage and a check that the same failure family cannot silently recur.
requirements.full_text: Incident Learning - Every meaningful reliability, spend, evidence or customer-impact incident produces root cause, durable prevention, regression coverage and a check that the same failure family cannot silently recur.

requirements.title: No Busywork Autonomy
requirements.text: Continuous operation does not mean constant paid inference or constant code churn. When no evidence-backed improvement is warranted, Brambleloop may remain stable rather than manufacturing work.
requirements.full_text: No Busywork Autonomy - Continuous operation does not mean constant paid inference or constant code churn. When no evidence-backed improvement is warranted, Brambleloop may remain stable rather than manufacturing work.

requirements.title: Improvement Value Ranking
requirements.text: Prioritize autonomous improvement by expected customer/business impact, risk reduction, confidence, cost and reversibility. Launch/revenue/customer blockers outrank elegance and theoretical optimization.
requirements.full_text: Improvement Value Ranking - Prioritize autonomous improvement by expected customer/business impact, risk reduction, confidence, cost and reversibility. Launch/revenue/customer blockers outrank elegance and theoretical optimization.

requirements.title: Owner Decision Compression
requirements.text: Brambleloop should resolve routine engineering/operational choices itself within policy and surface only genuinely consequential owner decisions with concise evidence, alternatives, cost and consequence of waiting.
requirements.full_text: Owner Decision Compression - Brambleloop should resolve routine engineering/operational choices itself within policy and surface only genuinely consequential owner decisions with concise evidence, alternatives, cost and consequence of waiting.

requirements.title: PC-Off Improvement Continuity
requirements.text: Cloud-resident learning/observation continues with HQ offline. HQ-only heavy development or archives may pause, but production-required observation, evidence capture and bounded improvement orchestration cannot require the owner PC.
requirements.full_text: PC-Off Improvement Continuity - Cloud-resident learning/observation continues with HQ offline. HQ-only heavy development or archives may pause, but production-required observation, evidence capture and bounded improvement orchestration cannot require the owner PC.

requirements.title: HQ Acceleration Without Dependency
requirements.text: When HQ is online, Brambleloop may exploit its storage/compute/development environment to accelerate analysis and builds; any artifact required by production must be promoted to durable cloud infrastructure before production depends on it.
requirements.full_text: HQ Acceleration Without Dependency - When HQ is online, Brambleloop may exploit its storage/compute/development environment to accelerate analysis and builds; any artifact required by production must be promoted to durable cloud infrastructure before production depends on it.

requirements.title: Improvement Audit Trail
requirements.text: Every adopted autonomous improvement records trigger/evidence, old version, new version, tests, quality-floor verdicts, spend, deployment, observed outcome and rollback reference.
requirements.full_text: Improvement Audit Trail - Every adopted autonomous improvement records trigger/evidence, old version, new version, tests, quality-floor verdicts, spend, deployment, observed outcome and rollback reference.

requirements.title: Learning Health Metrics
requirements.text: Expose useful improvement health: opportunities detected, experiments run, adoption/rejection rate, regressions caught, repeated-failure avoidance, cost per adopted improvement, and business impact where measurable.
requirements.full_text: Learning Health Metrics - Expose useful improvement health: opportunities detected, experiments run, adoption/rejection rate, regressions caught, repeated-failure avoidance, cost per adopted improvement, and business impact where measurable.

requirements.title: Never-Finished Company, Finite Launch
requirements.text: Brambleloop is designed to keep improving indefinitely after launch, but continuous improvement must never make launch completion impossible. Separate launch blockers from post-launch required work and optimization; the existence of another possible improvement is not itself a launch blocker.
requirements.full_text: Never-Finished Company, Finite Launch - Brambleloop is designed to keep improving indefinitely after launch, but continuous improvement must never make launch completion impossible. Separate launch blockers from post-launch required work and optimization; the existence of another possible improvement is not itself a launch blocker.

requirements.title: First-Class Research Agent
requirements.text: Operate a dedicated research capability that can be invoked by other agents and can autonomously recognize research-worthy uncertainty within its authority.
requirements.full_text: First-Class Research Agent - Operate a dedicated research capability that can be invoked by other agents and can autonomously recognize research-worthy uncertainty within its authority.

requirements.title: Research-Before-Invention
requirements.text: For material unknowns, search internal evidence first and then appropriate current external sources before designing novel machinery from first principles.
requirements.full_text: Research-Before-Invention - For material unknowns, search internal evidence first and then appropriate current external sources before designing novel machinery from first principles.

requirements.title: Unknown Detection
requirements.text: Agents must explicitly identify uncertainty, missing evidence, stale knowledge, conflicting evidence, unfamiliar failure modes and capability gaps rather than silently filling them with plausible assumptions.
requirements.full_text: Unknown Detection - Agents must explicitly identify uncertainty, missing evidence, stale knowledge, conflicting evidence, unfamiliar failure modes and capability gaps rather than silently filling them with plausible assumptions.

requirements.title: Confidence Trigger
requirements.text: Material decisions made from weak, stale, indirect or conflicting evidence trigger research before implementation when research can materially reduce uncertainty.
requirements.full_text: Confidence Trigger - Material decisions made from weak, stale, indirect or conflicting evidence trigger research before implementation when research can materially reduce uncertainty.

requirements.title: Internal Evidence First
requirements.text: Search BUILD_STATE, DECISION_LOG, experiments, incidents, durable lessons, benchmarks, source data, prior failures, tests and current production evidence before paying to rediscover an answer externally.
requirements.full_text: Internal Evidence First - Search BUILD_STATE, DECISION_LOG, experiments, incidents, durable lessons, benchmarks, source data, prior failures, tests and current production evidence before paying to rediscover an answer externally.

requirements.title: External Research Escalation
requirements.text: When internal evidence is insufficient, use current external research appropriate to the question rather than treating the model's pretrained knowledge as current authority.
requirements.full_text: External Research Escalation - When internal evidence is insufficient, use current external research appropriate to the question rather than treating the model's pretrained knowledge as current authority.

requirements.title: Source Hierarchy
requirements.text: Prefer primary and authoritative sources: official documentation/APIs/policies, original academic papers, standards, first-party marketplace material and original repositories. Use secondary/community sources for practical evidence and discovery, clearly distinguished from primary authority.
requirements.full_text: Source Hierarchy - Prefer primary and authoritative sources: official documentation/APIs/policies, original academic papers, standards, first-party marketplace material and original repositories. Use secondary/community sources for practical evidence and discovery, clearly distinguished from primary authority.

requirements.title: Multi-Source Verification
requirements.text: Consequential findings should be cross-checked against multiple independent sources where practical. A single search result is not automatically established truth.
requirements.full_text: Multi-Source Verification - Consequential findings should be cross-checked against multiple independent sources where practical. A single search result is not automatically established truth.

requirements.title: Fact / Claim / Inference Separation
requirements.text: Research artifacts distinguish directly observed facts, source claims, Brambleloop inference, hypothesis and unresolved uncertainty. Do not flatten these into one confidence class.
requirements.full_text: Fact / Claim / Inference Separation - Research artifacts distinguish directly observed facts, source claims, Brambleloop inference, hypothesis and unresolved uncertainty. Do not flatten these into one confidence class.

requirements.title: Recency Awareness
requirements.text: Time-sensitive technical, marketplace, pricing, policy, platform and API claims must be checked for freshness. Record retrieval date/version and avoid treating historical behavior as current without evidence.
requirements.full_text: Recency Awareness - Time-sensitive technical, marketplace, pricing, policy, platform and API claims must be checked for freshness. Record retrieval date/version and avoid treating historical behavior as current without evidence.

requirements.title: Applicability Test
requirements.text: Finding an established method does not authorize adoption. Evaluate whether its assumptions, topology, scale, data, runtime and failure modes transfer to Brambleloop's actual problem.
requirements.full_text: Applicability Test - Finding an established method does not authorize adoption. Evaluate whether its assumptions, topology, scale, data, runtime and failure modes transfer to Brambleloop's actual problem.

requirements.title: Research-to-Experiment Bridge
requirements.text: Translate promising research into the smallest bounded experiment that can falsify or support its applicability before a large build or spend.
requirements.full_text: Research-to-Experiment Bridge - Translate promising research into the smallest bounded experiment that can falsify or support its applicability before a large build or spend.

requirements.title: Existing Work Before Reinvention
requirements.text: Prefer adapting proven methods, libraries, algorithms, renderers, standards and open implementations when they satisfy requirements, rather than rebuilding mature infrastructure unnecessarily.
requirements.full_text: Existing Work Before Reinvention - Prefer adapting proven methods, libraries, algorithms, renderers, standards and open implementations when they satisfy requirements, rather than rebuilding mature infrastructure unnecessarily.

requirements.title: Custom Invention Permitted
requirements.text: Novel Brambleloop-specific engineering remains allowed when research shows existing methods are inadequate, incompatible, unavailable, unsafe, uneconomic or insufficiently truthful.
requirements.full_text: Custom Invention Permitted - Novel Brambleloop-specific engineering remains allowed when research shows existing methods are inadequate, incompatible, unavailable, unsafe, uneconomic or insufficiently truthful.

requirements.title: Licensing / IP Review
requirements.text: Before adopting external code, models, datasets, assets or methods with implementation implications, record applicable license, attribution, commercial-use constraints and material IP restrictions.
requirements.full_text: Licensing / IP Review - Before adopting external code, models, datasets, assets or methods with implementation implications, record applicable license, attribution, commercial-use constraints and material IP restrictions.

requirements.title: Security / Supply-Chain Review
requirements.text: External packages, repositories, binaries, services and models require appropriate provenance/security review before entering production or trusted build infrastructure.
requirements.full_text: Security / Supply-Chain Review - External packages, repositories, binaries, services and models require appropriate provenance/security review before entering production or trusted build infrastructure.

requirements.title: Cost & Infrastructure Review
requirements.text: Research adoption must record material compute, API, storage, GPU/CPU, deployment, maintenance and per-unit operating implications before architecture is committed.
requirements.full_text: Cost & Infrastructure Review - Research adoption must record material compute, API, storage, GPU/CPU, deployment, maintenance and per-unit operating implications before architecture is committed.

requirements.title: Research Spend Governance
requirements.text: Research uses existing owner-approved spend ceilings. The Research Agent cannot raise its own budget or turn open-ended curiosity into uncontrolled paid browsing/inference.
requirements.full_text: Research Spend Governance - Research uses existing owner-approved spend ceilings. The Research Agent cannot raise its own budget or turn open-ended curiosity into uncontrolled paid browsing/inference.

requirements.title: Research Stop Conditions
requirements.text: Each substantial research task defines the question, evidence needed, time/spend bound and stop condition so research cannot become endless exploration.
requirements.full_text: Research Stop Conditions - Each substantial research task defines the question, evidence needed, time/spend bound and stop condition so research cannot become endless exploration.

requirements.title: No Research Theatre
requirements.text: Do not collect sources merely to appear rigorous. Research must change confidence, narrow alternatives, establish a constraint, produce a testable hypothesis or justify stopping.
requirements.full_text: No Research Theatre - Do not collect sources merely to appear rigorous. Research must change confidence, narrow alternatives, establish a constraint, produce a testable hypothesis or justify stopping.

requirements.title: Search Strategy
requirements.text: Use iterative search: broad discovery -> terminology extraction -> authoritative source retrieval -> contradiction/alternative search -> implementation evidence -> synthesis.
requirements.full_text: Search Strategy - Use iterative search: broad discovery -> terminology extraction -> authoritative source retrieval -> contradiction/alternative search -> implementation evidence -> synthesis.

requirements.title: Terminology Discovery
requirements.text: When the system does not know the right vocabulary, use exploratory research to discover field-specific terminology before concluding that relevant work does not exist.
requirements.full_text: Terminology Discovery - When the system does not know the right vocabulary, use exploratory research to discover field-specific terminology before concluding that relevant work does not exist.

requirements.title: Cross-Domain Transfer
requirements.text: Search adjacent fields when underlying mechanics transfer - e.g., knitting/textile simulation for yarn geometry - while explicitly preserving domain differences such as crochet topology.
requirements.full_text: Cross-Domain Transfer - Search adjacent fields when underlying mechanics transfer - e.g., knitting/textile simulation for yarn geometry - while explicitly preserving domain differences such as crochet topology.

requirements.title: Research Reproducibility
requirements.text: Record queries/terms, source identifiers/URLs where permitted, versions/dates, key evidence, extracted constraints and resulting decisions sufficiently for later audit/reproduction.
requirements.full_text: Research Reproducibility - Record queries/terms, source identifiers/URLs where permitted, versions/dates, key evidence, extracted constraints and resulting decisions sufficiently for later audit/reproduction.

requirements.title: Citation / Provenance
requirements.text: Material research conclusions retain source provenance. Future agents must be able to tell why the system believes a claim and where the supporting evidence came from.
requirements.full_text: Citation / Provenance - Material research conclusions retain source provenance. Future agents must be able to tell why the system believes a claim and where the supporting evidence came from.

requirements.title: Contradiction Handling
requirements.text: Conflicting credible sources trigger explicit reconciliation or an unresolved state. Do not choose the convenient source silently.
requirements.full_text: Contradiction Handling - Conflicting credible sources trigger explicit reconciliation or an unresolved state. Do not choose the convenient source silently.

requirements.title: Negative Evidence
requirements.text: Record well-designed failed experiments and authoritative negative findings as durable knowledge; absence of success is not proof of impossibility unless the evidence supports that scope.
requirements.full_text: Negative Evidence - Record well-designed failed experiments and authoritative negative findings as durable knowledge; absence of success is not proof of impossibility unless the evidence supports that scope.

requirements.title: Scope Discipline
requirements.text: A failed implementation rejects only the tested method/class at the supported scope. Do not generalize a glyph-render failure into 'deterministic rendering is impossible' without evidence.
requirements.full_text: Scope Discipline - A failed implementation rejects only the tested method/class at the supported scope. Do not generalize a glyph-render failure into 'deterministic rendering is impossible' without evidence.

requirements.title: Research Agent Can Challenge Architecture
requirements.text: When credible evidence contradicts a current assumption, the Research Agent may flag architecture for review rather than forcing evidence to fit the existing design.
requirements.full_text: Research Agent Can Challenge Architecture - When credible evidence contradicts a current assumption, the Research Agent may flag architecture for review rather than forcing evidence to fit the existing design.

requirements.title: Research Agent Cannot Override Hard Floors
requirements.text: External research cannot be used to rationalize weakening Product Truth, quality, identity, spend, policy, security or owner-authority gates.
requirements.full_text: Research Agent Cannot Override Hard Floors - External research cannot be used to rationalize weakening Product Truth, quality, identity, spend, policy, security or owner-authority gates.

requirements.title: Durable Knowledge Promotion
requirements.text: Validated research findings become structured durable knowledge, regression tests, capability metadata, architecture notes or decision records so later agents reuse them.
requirements.full_text: Durable Knowledge Promotion - Validated research findings become structured durable knowledge, regression tests, capability metadata, architecture notes or decision records so later agents reuse them.

requirements.title: Deduplication / Research Memory
requirements.text: Before starting research, check whether the same question or materially equivalent premise has already been answered. Reopen only with new evidence, changed assumptions or expired/stale findings.
requirements.full_text: Deduplication / Research Memory - Before starting research, check whether the same question or materially equivalent premise has already been answered. Reopen only with new evidence, changed assumptions or expired/stale findings.

requirements.title: Research Freshness
requirements.text: Durable research carries freshness/expiry semantics appropriate to the domain; evergreen mathematics differs from Etsy policy, API behavior, pricing or marketplace demand.
requirements.full_text: Research Freshness - Durable research carries freshness/expiry semantics appropriate to the domain; evergreen mathematics differs from Etsy policy, API behavior, pricing or marketplace demand.

requirements.title: Automatic Re-Research
requirements.text: Where a decision depends on volatile external facts, schedule or trigger re-research when the evidence becomes stale, a dependency changes, an incident occurs or contradictory live evidence appears.
requirements.full_text: Automatic Re-Research - Where a decision depends on volatile external facts, schedule or trigger re-research when the evidence becomes stale, a dependency changes, an incident occurs or contradictory live evidence appears.

requirements.title: Research Outputs Are Machine-Usable
requirements.text: Produce structured conclusions including question, answer/status, confidence, evidence, alternatives, constraints, applicability, unresolved issues and recommended bounded next test.
requirements.full_text: Research Outputs Are Machine-Usable - Produce structured conclusions including question, answer/status, confidence, evidence, alternatives, constraints, applicability, unresolved issues and recommended bounded next test.

requirements.title: Research Agent Tool Choice
requirements.text: Use the lowest-cost adequate research method: internal retrieval, official docs, web search, academic literature, repository inspection, marketplace observation, controlled browser work or bounded experiment.
requirements.full_text: Research Agent Tool Choice - Use the lowest-cost adequate research method: internal retrieval, official docs, web search, academic literature, repository inspection, marketplace observation, controlled browser work or bounded experiment.

requirements.title: Primary Documentation for Integrations
requirements.text: For APIs/platform behavior, consult current official documentation and live capability evidence before coding around remembered behavior.
requirements.full_text: Primary Documentation for Integrations - For APIs/platform behavior, consult current official documentation and live capability evidence before coding around remembered behavior.

requirements.title: Academic / Technical Research
requirements.text: For hard engineering/scientific gaps, actively search original papers, technical reports, reference implementations and established tools before inventing bespoke algorithms.
requirements.full_text: Academic / Technical Research - For hard engineering/scientific gaps, actively search original papers, technical reports, reference implementations and established tools before inventing bespoke algorithms.

requirements.title: Marketplace Research
requirements.text: For Etsy/customer/product questions, combine marketplace evidence with first-party platform guidance and Brambleloop's own observed performance; do not equate search-result popularity with causal demand.
requirements.full_text: Marketplace Research - For Etsy/customer/product questions, combine marketplace evidence with first-party platform guidance and Brambleloop's own observed performance; do not equate search-result popularity with causal demand.

requirements.title: Competitive Learning Without Blind Copying
requirements.text: Research competitor catalogues, merchandising, pricing, product families and customer expectations as evidence, while requiring Brambleloop-specific differentiation and independent Product Truth.
requirements.full_text: Competitive Learning Without Blind Copying - Research competitor catalogues, merchandising, pricing, product families and customer expectations as evidence, while requiring Brambleloop-specific differentiation and independent Product Truth.

requirements.title: Research-Driven Dependency Selection
requirements.text: New dependencies/providers are chosen from measured fit, license, reliability, maintenance, cost and reversibility - not because they are fashionable or first in search results.
requirements.full_text: Research-Driven Dependency Selection - New dependencies/providers are chosen from measured fit, license, reliability, maintenance, cost and reversibility - not because they are fashionable or first in search results.

requirements.title: Benchmark Acquisition Logic
requirements.text: When a real external benchmark can answer a material unknown more cheaply/reliably than continued synthetic testing, surface the acquisition to the owner with expected information value before purchase.
requirements.full_text: Benchmark Acquisition Logic - When a real external benchmark can answer a material unknown more cheaply/reliably than continued synthetic testing, surface the acquisition to the owner with expected information value before purchase.

requirements.title: Real-Object Benchmarking
requirements.text: Use real products/patterns/objects where appropriate to validate architecture against external reality; preserve what the source can and cannot establish.
requirements.full_text: Real-Object Benchmarking - Use real products/patterns/objects where appropriate to validate architecture against external reality; preserve what the source can and cannot establish.

requirements.title: Research Failure Escalation
requirements.text: If research cannot resolve a material unknown, report what was searched, what remains unknown, why it matters and the smallest owner/external action capable of resolving it.
requirements.full_text: Research Failure Escalation - If research cannot resolve a material unknown, report what was searched, what remains unknown, why it matters and the smallest owner/external action capable of resolving it.

requirements.title: No Fabricated Citations or Capabilities
requirements.text: Never invent a source, paper, repository, API feature, benchmark result or external capability. Unknown remains unknown until evidenced.
requirements.full_text: No Fabricated Citations or Capabilities - Never invent a source, paper, repository, API feature, benchmark result or external capability. Unknown remains unknown until evidenced.

requirements.title: Research Parallelism
requirements.text: Research may run alongside unrelated executable work when safe, so a blocked research question does not freeze the whole business.
requirements.full_text: Research Parallelism - Research may run alongside unrelated executable work when safe, so a blocked research question does not freeze the whole business.

requirements.title: Research Agent Authority Boundary
requirements.text: The Research Agent gathers, evaluates and recommends. Adoption follows the authority model of the affected subsystem; research itself does not grant deployment/publishing/spend authority.
requirements.full_text: Research Agent Authority Boundary - The Research Agent gathers, evaluates and recommends. Adoption follows the authority model of the affected subsystem; research itself does not grant deployment/publishing/spend authority.

requirements.title: Learning From Owner Discovery
requirements.text: When the owner supplies useful external evidence or terminology, ingest it as research evidence, verify where appropriate, and update durable knowledge rather than treating it as a one-off chat hint.
requirements.full_text: Learning From Owner Discovery - When the owner supplies useful external evidence or terminology, ingest it as research evidence, verify where appropriate, and update durable knowledge rather than treating it as a one-off chat hint.

requirements.title: Research Quality Metrics
requirements.text: Track research questions resolved, reuse rate, stale findings refreshed, duplicate research avoided, experiments prevented, spend avoided, source quality and downstream decisions materially improved.
requirements.full_text: Research Quality Metrics - Track research questions resolved, reuse rate, stale findings refreshed, duplicate research avoided, experiments prevented, spend avoided, source quality and downstream decisions materially improved.

requirements.title: Research as Core Autonomy
requirements.text: A mature Brambleloop should not require the owner to Google routine unknowns. Detecting 'I do not know enough yet' and autonomously researching the answer is a core 24/7 self-improvement capability.
requirements.full_text: Research as Core Autonomy - A mature Brambleloop should not require the owner to Google routine unknowns. Detecting 'I do not know enough yet' and autonomously researching the answer is a core 24/7 self-improvement capability.

requirements.title: Master Orchestrator
requirements.text: Maintain a master orchestrator with visibility across requirements, departments, dependencies, owner gates, external blockers, spend, deployments and active work.
requirements.full_text: Master Orchestrator - Maintain a master orchestrator with visibility across requirements, departments, dependencies, owner gates, external blockers, spend, deployments and active work.

requirements.title: Dependency DAG
requirements.text: Represent substantial build/operational work as a dependency graph. A task waits only for dependencies it genuinely requires; unrelated work remains dispatchable.
requirements.full_text: Dependency DAG - Represent substantial build/operational work as a dependency graph. A task waits only for dependencies it genuinely requires; unrelated work remains dispatchable.

requirements.title: Work-Conserving Scheduler
requirements.text: Whenever safe independent READY work exists and capacity is available, dispatch it. A long render, research run, test suite or blocked integration cannot idle unrelated departments.
requirements.full_text: Work-Conserving Scheduler - Whenever safe independent READY work exists and capacity is available, dispatch it. A long render, research run, test suite or blocked integration cannot idle unrelated departments.

requirements.title: Department Agents
requirements.text: Use focused agents/workers for distinct domains such as Research, Pattern/CIR Engineering, Visuals, QA, Etsy/Commerce, SEO/Marketing, Catalogue, Analytics, Customer Experience, Finance/Cost, Reliability and Integration.
requirements.full_text: Department Agents - Use focused agents/workers for distinct domains such as Research, Pattern/CIR Engineering, Visuals, QA, Etsy/Commerce, SEO/Marketing, Catalogue, Analytics, Customer Experience, Finance/Cost, Reliability and Integration.

requirements.title: Context Isolation
requirements.text: Department agents receive the context/evidence relevant to their work rather than carrying the entire company's unrelated history, reducing distraction, token cost and cross-domain assumption leakage.
requirements.full_text: Context Isolation - Department agents receive the context/evidence relevant to their work rather than carrying the entire company's unrelated history, reducing distraction, token cost and cross-domain assumption leakage.

requirements.title: Shared Truth Contracts
requirements.text: Cross-department contracts - CIR schemas, product IDs, listing schemas, evidence formats, APIs and quality floors - are versioned and authoritative. Agents do not silently redefine shared contracts locally.
requirements.full_text: Shared Truth Contracts - Cross-department contracts - CIR schemas, product IDs, listing schemas, evidence formats, APIs and quality floors - are versioned and authoritative. Agents do not silently redefine shared contracts locally.

requirements.title: Ownership Boundaries
requirements.text: Assign clear code/data/module ownership for active tasks. Two agents may not concurrently make incompatible edits to the same shared surface without explicit coordination.
requirements.full_text: Ownership Boundaries - Assign clear code/data/module ownership for active tasks. Two agents may not concurrently make incompatible edits to the same shared surface without explicit coordination.

requirements.title: Isolated Workspaces
requirements.text: Concurrent engineering uses isolated branches/worktrees or equivalent safe workspaces so one agent's incomplete changes do not contaminate another agent's validation.
requirements.full_text: Isolated Workspaces - Concurrent engineering uses isolated branches/worktrees or equivalent safe workspaces so one agent's incomplete changes do not contaminate another agent's validation.

requirements.title: Merge Queue
requirements.text: Completed department changes enter a controlled integration/merge queue. Shared-branch races and last-writer-wins development are prohibited.
requirements.full_text: Merge Queue - Completed department changes enter a controlled integration/merge queue. Shared-branch races and last-writer-wins development are prohibited.

requirements.title: Integration Agent
requirements.text: A dedicated integration responsibility resolves cross-department conflicts, validates shared contracts and assembles compatible changes before production deployment.
requirements.full_text: Integration Agent - A dedicated integration responsibility resolves cross-department conflicts, validates shared contracts and assembles compatible changes before production deployment.

requirements.title: Deploy Serialization
requirements.text: Production deployments are serialized/controlled even when development is parallel. Agents cannot independently race deployments or overwrite a newer verified production state.
requirements.full_text: Deploy Serialization - Production deployments are serialized/controlled even when development is parallel. Agents cannot independently race deployments or overwrite a newer verified production state.

requirements.title: Lease Scope
requirements.text: Use the narrowest safe lock/lease scope. A deployment or shared-schema lock must not unnecessarily freeze unrelated research, drafting, analysis or isolated development.
requirements.full_text: Lease Scope - Use the narrowest safe lock/lease scope. A deployment or shared-schema lock must not unnecessarily freeze unrelated research, drafting, analysis or isolated development.

requirements.title: Long-Running Task Handoff
requirements.text: Renders, suites, research jobs and external waits persist durable job state so the initiating agent can yield capacity while another observer/job system tracks completion.
requirements.full_text: Long-Running Task Handoff - Renders, suites, research jobs and external waits persist durable job state so the initiating agent can yield capacity while another observer/job system tracks completion.

requirements.title: No Waiter Occupancy
requirements.text: An agent does not consume a scarce execution slot merely waiting on a durable long-running operation when it can safely perform or dispatch other work.
requirements.full_text: No Waiter Occupancy - An agent does not consume a scarce execution slot merely waiting on a durable long-running operation when it can safely perform or dispatch other work.

requirements.title: Critical-Path Awareness
requirements.text: Continuously calculate launch/business critical paths and prioritize work that shortens them, while still using spare capacity for independent non-critical but valuable work.
requirements.full_text: Critical-Path Awareness - Continuously calculate launch/business critical paths and prioritize work that shortens them, while still using spare capacity for independent non-critical but valuable work.

requirements.title: Blocker Fan-Out
requirements.text: When a blocker is discovered, identify every requirement actually dependent on it and only those requirements. Do not allow a local blocker to become a global stop.
requirements.full_text: Blocker Fan-Out - When a blocker is discovered, identify every requirement actually dependent on it and only those requirements. Do not allow a local blocker to become a global stop.

requirements.title: Unblock Fan-Out
requirements.text: When a gate opens or dependency completes, immediately recompute downstream readiness and dispatch newly READY work without waiting for a manual heartbeat.
requirements.full_text: Unblock Fan-Out - When a gate opens or dependency completes, immediately recompute downstream readiness and dispatch newly READY work without waiting for a manual heartbeat.

requirements.title: Parallel Build-2 Completion
requirements.text: During pre-launch Build 2, independent remaining requirements should execute concurrently by department where safe, rather than sequentially waiting for the current headline blocker.
requirements.full_text: Parallel Build-2 Completion - During pre-launch Build 2, independent remaining requirements should execute concurrently by department where safe, rather than sequentially waiting for the current headline blocker.

requirements.title: Parallel Post-Launch Operation
requirements.text: After launch, Research, product creation, pattern engineering, visual production, commerce, marketing, analytics, support and reliability continue concurrently within resource/authority limits.
requirements.full_text: Parallel Post-Launch Operation - After launch, Research, product creation, pattern engineering, visual production, commerce, marketing, analytics, support and reliability continue concurrently within resource/authority limits.

requirements.title: Resource-Aware Concurrency
requirements.text: Concurrency respects CPU, memory, storage, provider rate limits, database capacity, Railway capacity and other shared resources. Parallelism cannot destabilize production.
requirements.full_text: Resource-Aware Concurrency - Concurrency respects CPU, memory, storage, provider rate limits, database capacity, Railway capacity and other shared resources. Parallelism cannot destabilize production.

requirements.title: Spend-Aware Concurrency
requirements.text: Maintain aggregate spend reservations across concurrent agents. Five agents cannot each interpret the same remaining budget as independently available.
requirements.full_text: Spend-Aware Concurrency - Maintain aggregate spend reservations across concurrent agents. Five agents cannot each interpret the same remaining budget as independently available.

requirements.title: Provider Concurrency Governance
requirements.text: Centralize provider/API rate-limit and spend coordination so concurrent departments cannot create retry storms, duplicate experiments or surprise billing.
requirements.full_text: Provider Concurrency Governance - Centralize provider/API rate-limit and spend coordination so concurrent departments cannot create retry storms, duplicate experiments or surprise billing.

requirements.title: Priority Preemption
requirements.text: Higher-value launch/customer/reliability work may preempt lower-value optimization when capacity is constrained, while preserving durable state for later resumption.
requirements.full_text: Priority Preemption - Higher-value launch/customer/reliability work may preempt lower-value optimization when capacity is constrained, while preserving durable state for later resumption.

requirements.title: Safe Pause/Resume
requirements.text: Department work can pause and resume from durable checkpoints without losing evidence, repeating paid work or requiring the original agent session to remain alive.
requirements.full_text: Safe Pause/Resume - Department work can pause and resume from durable checkpoints without losing evidence, repeating paid work or requiring the original agent session to remain alive.

requirements.title: Cross-Agent Evidence Reuse
requirements.text: Evidence produced by one department is discoverable and reusable by others through durable provenance rather than being trapped in one agent's context.
requirements.full_text: Cross-Agent Evidence Reuse - Evidence produced by one department is discoverable and reusable by others through durable provenance rather than being trapped in one agent's context.

requirements.title: No Duplicate Department Work
requirements.text: Before dispatch, check active/completed jobs and evidence fingerprints so multiple agents do not unknowingly solve the same question in parallel.
requirements.full_text: No Duplicate Department Work - Before dispatch, check active/completed jobs and evidence fingerprints so multiple agents do not unknowingly solve the same question in parallel.

requirements.title: Independent QA
requirements.text: Where practical, the agent that builds a consequential artifact is not the sole authority that certifies it. QA consumes the artifact/evidence independently.
requirements.full_text: Independent QA - Where practical, the agent that builds a consequential artifact is not the sole authority that certifies it. QA consumes the artifact/evidence independently.

requirements.title: Parallel Research
requirements.text: Research Agent may investigate blockers/opportunities while engineering continues on independent work; research does not require the whole company to wait.
requirements.full_text: Parallel Research - Research Agent may investigate blockers/opportunities while engineering continues on independent work; research does not require the whole company to wait.

requirements.title: Parallel Etsy Preparation
requirements.text: Storefront, SEO, listing schemas, policies, merchandising, analytics preparation and other non-image-dependent Etsy work may proceed while visual R&D; remains blocked, subject to Shadow Mode.
requirements.full_text: Parallel Etsy Preparation - Storefront, SEO, listing schemas, policies, merchandising, analytics preparation and other non-image-dependent Etsy work may proceed while visual R&D; remains blocked, subject to Shadow Mode.

requirements.title: Parallel Catalogue Work
requirements.text: Research/design/certification work on products that do not depend on an unresolved downstream presentation step can continue, while publication remains gated by complete launch floors.
requirements.full_text: Parallel Catalogue Work - Research/design/certification work on products that do not depend on an unresolved downstream presentation step can continue, while publication remains gated by complete launch floors.

requirements.title: Parallel Reliability Work
requirements.text: Reliability, observability, cost governance and regression work may proceed independently when it does not alter shared contracts under active modification.
requirements.full_text: Parallel Reliability Work - Reliability, observability, cost governance and regression work may proceed independently when it does not alter shared contracts under active modification.

requirements.title: Contract Change Barrier
requirements.text: A department changing a shared schema/API/CIR contract declares the change before merge; dependent agents either pin the old version or explicitly migrate. Silent contract drift is prohibited.
requirements.full_text: Contract Change Barrier - A department changing a shared schema/API/CIR contract declares the change before merge; dependent agents either pin the old version or explicitly migrate. Silent contract drift is prohibited.

requirements.title: Integration Regression Gate
requirements.text: Parallel speed never bypasses integrated validation. Merged changes run the appropriate targeted and full regression suites before production maturity is claimed.
requirements.full_text: Integration Regression Gate - Parallel speed never bypasses integrated validation. Merged changes run the appropriate targeted and full regression suites before production maturity is claimed.

requirements.title: Conflict Detection
requirements.text: Detect overlapping file/module/schema ownership before work begins where possible, not only at merge time.
requirements.full_text: Conflict Detection - Detect overlapping file/module/schema ownership before work begins where possible, not only at merge time.

requirements.title: Deadlock Detection
requirements.text: The orchestrator detects circular dependencies, stale locks and mutually waiting departments; it surfaces/fixes orchestration deadlocks instead of reporting the company as merely busy.
requirements.full_text: Deadlock Detection - The orchestrator detects circular dependencies, stale locks and mutually waiting departments; it surfaces/fixes orchestration deadlocks instead of reporting the company as merely busy.

requirements.title: Starvation Prevention
requirements.text: Long-running high-profile work cannot permanently starve smaller READY tasks. Scheduler fairness is balanced against critical-path priority.
requirements.full_text: Starvation Prevention - Long-running high-profile work cannot permanently starve smaller READY tasks. Scheduler fairness is balanced against critical-path priority.

requirements.title: Department Health
requirements.text: Expose each department's active task, blocker, READY backlog, last durable progress, spend, output/evidence and whether capacity is idle.
requirements.full_text: Department Health - Expose each department's active task, blocker, READY backlog, last durable progress, spend, output/evidence and whether capacity is idle.

requirements.title: Company-Wide Progress
requirements.text: Expose business progress across departments: launch blockers closed, listable products, storefront readiness, integration readiness and critical-path movement - not only commits/tests from the busiest department.
requirements.full_text: Company-Wide Progress - Expose business progress across departments: launch blockers closed, listable products, storefront readiness, integration readiness and critical-path movement - not only commits/tests from the busiest department.

requirements.title: Parallelism Efficiency
requirements.text: Measure wall-clock compression, idle-capacity time, duplicate-work avoidance, conflict rate, merge delay and useful throughput attributable to parallel execution.
requirements.full_text: Parallelism Efficiency - Measure wall-clock compression, idle-capacity time, duplicate-work avoidance, conflict rate, merge delay and useful throughput attributable to parallel execution.

requirements.title: Concurrency Backpressure
requirements.text: If conflicts, regressions, resource saturation or spend anomalies rise, reduce concurrency automatically rather than preserving agent count for appearance.
requirements.full_text: Concurrency Backpressure - If conflicts, regressions, resource saturation or spend anomalies rise, reduce concurrency automatically rather than preserving agent count for appearance.

requirements.title: Failure Isolation
requirements.text: A failed department task does not roll back unrelated validated work. Contain failures to their dependency branch and preserve successful independent outputs.
requirements.full_text: Failure Isolation - A failed department task does not roll back unrelated validated work. Contain failures to their dependency branch and preserve successful independent outputs.

requirements.title: Department-Specific Stop Conditions
requirements.text: Each workstream has its own success/stop/escalation criteria; one department reaching an owner gate does not create an owner gate for every department.
requirements.full_text: Department-Specific Stop Conditions - Each workstream has its own success/stop/escalation criteria; one department reaching an owner gate does not create an owner gate for every department.

requirements.title: Owner Decision Batching
requirements.text: Where possible, consolidate genuine owner decisions from multiple departments into concise evidence-backed batches rather than interrupting the owner repeatedly.
requirements.full_text: Owner Decision Batching - Where possible, consolidate genuine owner decisions from multiple departments into concise evidence-backed batches rather than interrupting the owner repeatedly.

requirements.title: Autonomous Dispatch
requirements.text: Within existing authority, the orchestrator may dispatch newly READY department work without waiting for the owner to say 'continue' after every completed task.
requirements.full_text: Autonomous Dispatch - Within existing authority, the orchestrator may dispatch newly READY department work without waiting for the owner to say 'continue' after every completed task.

requirements.title: 24/7 Parallel Continuity
requirements.text: Cloud departments continue independent authorized work while HQ is off and while other departments are blocked, sleeping, rendering or waiting on external systems.
requirements.full_text: 24/7 Parallel Continuity - Cloud departments continue independent authorized work while HQ is off and while other departments are blocked, sleeping, rendering or waiting on external systems.

requirements.title: HQ Acceleration Pool
requirements.text: When HQ compute is available, assign suitable heavy isolated workloads to it without making cloud production or scheduling dependent on HQ remaining online.
requirements.full_text: HQ Acceleration Pool - When HQ compute is available, assign suitable heavy isolated workloads to it without making cloud production or scheduling dependent on HQ remaining online.

requirements.title: Build vs Operate Separation
requirements.text: Development agents and production-operation agents have distinct authority and deployment paths. Building in parallel cannot destabilize the live business.
requirements.full_text: Build vs Operate Separation - Development agents and production-operation agents have distinct authority and deployment paths. Building in parallel cannot destabilize the live business.

requirements.title: Finite Parallel Launch
requirements.text: Parallelism is used to shorten the finite launch path, not to create infinite simultaneous pre-launch optimization. Launch blockers remain explicitly bounded.
requirements.full_text: Finite Parallel Launch - Parallelism is used to shorten the finite launch path, not to create infinite simultaneous pre-launch optimization. Launch blockers remain explicitly bounded.

requirements.title: Post-Launch Department Autonomy
requirements.text: Once live, each department may continuously improve within its approved authority while the orchestrator coordinates shared constraints and integration.
requirements.full_text: Post-Launch Department Autonomy - Once live, each department may continuously improve within its approved authority while the orchestrator coordinates shared constraints and integration.

requirements.title: Parallel Company Standard
requirements.text: Brambleloop's mature operating model is a dependency-aware parallel autonomous organization: many departments advancing simultaneously, one coherent source of truth, controlled integration, and no unnecessary global waiting.
requirements.full_text: Parallel Company Standard - Brambleloop's mature operating model is a dependency-aware parallel autonomous organization: many departments advancing simultaneously, one coherent source of truth, controlled integration, and no unnecessary global waiting.

requirements.title: Etsy Event Feedback
requirements.text: Supported Etsy events feed a durable, idempotent business-event layer after authenticated integration is proven.
requirements.full_text: Etsy Event Feedback - Supported Etsy events feed a durable, idempotent business-event layer after authenticated integration is proven.

requirements.title: Storefront Continuous Optimization
requirements.text: Continuously evaluate and improve Etsy listing/storefront presentation from real evidence.
requirements.full_text: Storefront Continuous Optimization - Continuously evaluate and improve Etsy listing/storefront presentation from real evidence.

requirements.title: Evidence-Driven Experiments
requirements.text: Storefront/business changes use bounded experiments with explicit hypotheses and outcome measurement.
requirements.full_text: Evidence-Driven Experiments - Storefront/business changes use bounded experiments with explicit hypotheses and outcome measurement.

requirements.title: Experiment Attribution
requirements.text: Record what changed, why, evidence, expected effect, measured effect, owner/department and retain/rollback decision.
requirements.full_text: Experiment Attribution - Record what changed, why, evidence, expected effect, measured effect, owner/department and retain/rollback decision.

requirements.title: Failure Memory
requirements.text: Persist failed experiments and causal findings so agents do not repeatedly rediscover known failures.
requirements.full_text: Failure Memory - Persist failed experiments and causal findings so agents do not repeatedly rediscover known failures.

requirements.title: Customer Feedback Loop
requirements.text: Questions, reviews, refunds, cancellations and support friction become structured improvement evidence.
requirements.full_text: Customer Feedback Loop - Questions, reviews, refunds, cancellations and support friction become structured improvement evidence.

requirements.title: Sales Feedback Loop
requirements.text: Sales and conversion evidence inform catalogue, pricing, merchandising and product-family decisions.
requirements.full_text: Sales Feedback Loop - Sales and conversion evidence inform catalogue, pricing, merchandising and product-family decisions.

requirements.title: SEO Learning Loop
requirements.text: Search/listing evidence informs titles, tags, attributes and discoverability experiments.
requirements.full_text: SEO Learning Loop - Search/listing evidence informs titles, tags, attributes and discoverability experiments.

requirements.title: Image Performance Loop
requirements.text: Listing-image ordering/presentation may improve from measured performance without weakening Product Truth.
requirements.full_text: Image Performance Loop - Listing-image ordering/presentation may improve from measured performance without weakening Product Truth.

requirements.title: Pricing Learning Loop
requirements.text: Pricing/promotion experiments remain bounded by margin, fee, spend and owner-policy floors.
requirements.full_text: Pricing Learning Loop - Pricing/promotion experiments remain bounded by margin, fee, spend and owner-policy floors.

requirements.title: Post-Launch Department Continuity
requirements.text: Every department has an ongoing evidence-backed improvement role after launch.
requirements.full_text: Post-Launch Department Continuity - Every department has an ongoing evidence-backed improvement role after launch.

requirements.title: Webhook Reliability
requirements.text: Webhook/event handling includes validation, idempotency, duplicate protection, retries, storage and observability.
requirements.full_text: Webhook Reliability - Webhook/event handling includes validation, idempotency, duplicate protection, retries, storage and observability.

requirements.title: Controlled Self-Improvement
requirements.text: Autonomous improvement operates through research, experiments, gates and controlled deployment - not unrestricted self-modification.
requirements.full_text: Controlled Self-Improvement - Autonomous improvement operates through research, experiments, gates and controlled deployment - not unrestricted self-modification.

requirements.title: Outcome-Based Improvement

requirements.title: Continuous Teaching Improvement

requirements.full_text: Continuous Teaching Improvement - Every lesson participates in OBSERVE -> HYPOTHESIS -> EXPERIMENT -> MEASURE -> VALIDATE -> PROMOTE/REJECT. Improve explanations, visuals, sequencing and formats while preserving the underlying technical truth.

requirements.full_text: Capability Proof Chain - COMPLETE+PROVEN requires the applicable chain: requirement -> producer -> durable evidence/state -> runtime consumer -> decision -> protected action/effect -> observable result -> independent proof.

requirements.title: Existence Is Not Execution
requirements.text: A module, function, handler, cadence, row, dashboard card or unit test cannot by itself prove a business capability operates.
requirements.full_text: Existence Is Not Execution - A module, function, handler, cadence, row, dashboard card or unit test cannot by itself prove a business capability operates.

requirements.title: Live-Root Reachability

requirements.full_text: Live-Root Reachability - Runtime requirements must be reachable from real scheduler/API/worker/event roots; arbitrary callable paths are insufficient.

requirements.title: Consumption Required

requirements.full_text: Consumption Required - Producing a reading is insufficient when the requirement exists to influence a downstream decision/action; prove the consumer.

requirements.title: Protected-Action Revalidation

requirements.title: No Fixture-Only Proof

requirements.title: Proxy Honesty

requirements.title: Closure Integrity

requirements.title: Green Suite Necessary, Not Sufficient

requirements.full_text: Green Suite Necessary, Not Sufficient - A green full suite is mandatory but cannot replace requirement-level runtime proof.

requirements.title: Final Build Purpose

requirements.full_text: Final Build Purpose - Final Build integrates the certified foundation, satisfies the Final Master, executes owner-gated activation, launch rehearsal, deployment, production observation and customer-ready polish.

requirements.title: Audit-Repair Loop

requirements.title: No Final-Build Drift

requirements.title: Shadow Rehearsal

requirements.full_text: Durable Handoffs - Long AI-development tasks persist objective, branch/head, decisions, defects, tests, unfinished work and next actions.

requirements.full_text: Session-Limit Survival - Checkpoint partial work, patch series and assignments before session limits can kill subagents.

requirements.title: Bounded Parallelism

requirements.full_text: Bounded Parallelism - Use disjoint ownership and one integrator; optimize for integrated tested work per resource window, not maximum agent count.

requirements.title: Independent Model Review

requirements.full_text: Independent Model Review - A second model may adversarially review evidence without becoming certification authority.

requirements.title: Worker Does Not Self-Certify

requirements.full_text: Worker Does Not Self-Certify - Implementation workers return tested candidates; high-risk completion is independently adjudicated.

requirements.title: Empirical Model Routing
requirements.text: Route Claude/Opus, Fable, Codex/Astra and future models by demonstrated outcome, cost, latency, context and tool fit.
requirements.full_text: Empirical Model Routing - Route Claude/Opus, Fable, Codex/Astra and future models by demonstrated outcome, cost, latency, context and tool fit.

requirements.title: Approval Friction Is Cost

requirements.full_text: Approval Friction Is Cost - Measure excessive development approval prompts as throughput loss; prefer bounded autonomous sandboxes while keeping production/spend/credential gates.

requirements.title: Owner Action Packets

requirements.full_text: Owner Action Packets - Every owner gate states exact action, why software cannot do it, time/cost, unlock and consequence of delay.
